title: Digital Product Owner - B2B
description:
* **Backlog Ownership:** Own and maintain a single, prioritized product backlog for B2B Commerce and supporting sales tools. Author well-structured epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria, success metrics, and testable outcomes. Manage the allocation mix across feature work, tech debt, and platform optimization.
* **Delivery & Quality:** Play a key role throughout the development lifecycle, including sprint planning, refinement, review, and acceptance. Write acceptance criteria, execute acceptance tests, and collaborate with QA to embed a shift-left quality mindset. Partner with UX designers and front-end engineers to deliver user-friendly experiences for wholesale buyers and sales reps.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Serve as the primary product liaison between the GCC engineering squad and Portland-based business stakeholders in Sales Operations, Account Operations, and Sales Management. Synthesize competing input from multiple regions (US, Canada, Europe, IDR) and brands into a coherent backlog. Maintain a regular cadence of async updates, decision logs, and roadmap reviews that keep distributed partners aligned.
* **Roadmap Execution:** Execute the product vision and roadmap for B2B Commerce. Track, analyze, and surface end-user feedback from wholesale users to refine priorities. Anticipate dependencies across SAP, Salesforce, and enterprise data integrations, and sequence work accordingly.
* **Integration Fluency:** Understand how B2B Commerce solutions route orders through ERP platforms and how CRM platforms support the prospect-to-order lifecycle, rep assignments, case management, and customer agreements. Collaborate with integration teams to scope work realistically and flag infeasible requests early.
* **Documentation & Async Communication:** Produce self-contained epics, sprint summaries, decision logs, and stakeholder-facing artifacts that distributed teammates in Portland (13.5 hours behind Bengaluru) can act on independently. Maintain Confluence pages, Jira hygiene, and status updates that reduce the need for synchronous handoffs.

title: Product Lifecycle Manager
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Global BL Quality & Lifecycle Manager

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**  
  
As new industries turn to electrification, it is more vital than ever that we can support ABB’s customers with their new challenges and ensure that our Low Voltage System Drives products meet emerging requirements. That is why we are establishing a new role of Product Lifecycle Manager in our Quality & Lifecycle organization.

In this role, you will ensure that learnings from field performance and reliability testing reach all needed stakeholders for example in product management, R&D and sales. You will also analyze the effects of planned changes or new products on the existing technical offering and customer installed base. The target is to fully leverage accumulated product performance data to support business growth.

This role is contributing to ABB’s Low Voltage System Drives business line in Motion High Power division. You will work in close collaboration with stakeholders from division’s Product Management, Product Engineering, R&D and Service.  
  
This is a global role but location is set to be one of these: Finland (Helsinki), China (Beijing), Germany (Mannheim), USA (New Berlin, WI) or India (Bangalore). The work model for the role is: hybrid, #LI-Hybrid  
  
You will be mainly accountable for:

  

* Initial phase: Developing a new process, related documentation (reports, dashboards) and meeting practices to support efficient product lifecycle decision making and a learning organization
* Overseeing the process and ensuring execution of related tasks with stakeholders
* Coordinating and conducting change impact analysis of additions, enhancements or simplifications of the existing product portfolio
* Facilitating continuous improvements along with the execution of lifecycle changes
* Managing global projects, involving stakeholders from various functions and local units

**Qualifications for the role**

* 10+ years of experience on product engineering, product management, portfolio management, R&D or similar area.
* 5+ years experience in leading people with or without line manager authority
* M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree in electrical /electronics engineering, mechanical engineering or equivalent
* Experience on process development is a benefit
* Experience on frequency converters is an asset
* You enjoy taking on new challenges and working with people across different functions, perspectives, and backgrounds to move ideas forward.
* Readiness for international travel, estimated 15% of work time

**More about us**

ABB High Power division is the market leader in high-power, high-performance drives, drive systems and packages for industrial process and large infrastructure applications, and a leading supplier of power conversion equipment for renewable energy and other applications. The division offers global support to help customers, partners and equipment manufacturers with asset reliability, performance improvement and energy efficiency in mission critical applications.

If you have questions, please contact Global Business Line Quality & Lifecycle Manager, Johanna Honkanen, at one of these times (according to Finland’s time): Oct 29 between 1-3pm, or Nov 2 between 8.30-9.30am.
  
  
Interested in joining the crew? Please apply for the position by Nov 8, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application. #ABBCareers #Runwhatrunstheworld

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst IV
description:
**Who We Are**

  

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  
  

**What We Offer**

  

Location:

Bangalore,IND

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

**Business Intelligence Analyst IV**
====================================

**Who you'll work with**
------------------------

You will join Applied's APEX team, partnering directly with executives, operational leaders, Finance, and IT across multiple product lines. On any given initiative you will work alongside data engineers, operations and product managers, and functional specialists. [+India specific details]

**Your impact**
---------------

**This role combines business intelligence, market intelligence, strategic analysis, and data-driven decision support. The ideal candidate is highly curious, proactive, comfortable working in ambiguity, skilled in Excel-based modeling, and able to partner with different business units e.g., Business Management and Product Leaders to translate market, customer, and competitive insights into strategic recommendations.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Own the problem. Scope analytics and business intelligence initiatives supporting strategic, operational, market, and quality programs. Frame the question, develop hypotheses, gather data, design the analysis, and carry recommendations through to decision-making.**

* **Be the day-to-day partner to the business. Work closely with Business Management, GPMs, and BU leaders to understand business priorities, market opportunities, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics. Translate these needs into analytical frameworks and actionable insights.**

* **Drive market and competitive intelligence. Develop market sizing, TAM/SAM/SOM models, segment analyses, technology landscape assessments, competitive benchmarking, and industry trend reports to support business strategy and investment decisions.**

* **Research beyond the data. Gather and synthesize information from customer interactions, MRS documents, analyst reports, industry publications, earnings releases, market databases, and internal sources to build fact-based perspectives on markets and competitors.**

* **Turn analysis into language leaders act on. Interpret results in business, financial, and strategic terms for management and executives, tailoring messages appropriately for different audiences.**

* **Build practical business models. Develop Excel-based financial, market, and operational models that support scenario planning, opportunity assessment, prioritization, and executive decision making.**

* **Set the standard for data quality and insight generation. Ensure analytical rigor, data integrity, validation, and transparency of assumptions in all work products.**

* **Build the organization's shared knowledge base. Maintain reusable models, templates, market intelligence repositories, competitive assessments, and analytical frameworks that can be leveraged across teams.**

**Your growth**
---------------

You will have exposure to senior decision-makers from early on, breadth across Applied's product lines and functions, and a named senior colleague invested in your development. Over time, your role will move toward deeper technical leadership in analytics and data architecture, or toward broader functional and people leadership. In return for your drive and curiosity, we will give you the problems, the access, and the coaching to become a stronger leader faster than you expected.

**Your qualifications and skills**
----------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a quantitative, engineering, or business discipline preferred. Requirements may vary by region and function.

* Typically 12–18 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or consulting, including demonstrable time owning a workstream end to end.

* Ability to break down an ambiguous business problem through structured, quantitative reasoning, and to make decisions from data, facts, and logic rather than precedent.

* Demonstrated experience developing market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), business cases, competitive assessments, industry analyses, and strategic recommendations.

* Strong quantitative and financial modeling skills, including advanced Excel capabilities and the ability to develop practical, assumption-driven business models.

* Proven ability to conduct independent research and synthesize information from multiple sources into concise executive-level insights.

* Intellectual curiosity and a proactive mindset, with a track record of identifying opportunities, risks, and insights without waiting for direction.

* Strong business acumen and ability to connect market dynamics, customer requirements, competitive positioning, and financial outcomes.

* Experience working with Product Management, General/Product Managers, Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management teams is highly desirable.

* Semiconductor, high-technology, or high-volume manufacturing exposure is an advantage.

**Additional Information**

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Employee Type:**

Assignee / Regular

**Travel:**

**Relocation Eligible:**

No

Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Product Manager
description:
**Location: Kochi or Bengaluru, India**  
**Permanent - Full time**

**About Us**  
Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Product Manager to join the Flex Platform team, a cross-functional product organization responsible for building the shared platform capabilities, workflows, and services that power Cyncly's products globally.

You will own a defined product area end-to-end from understanding customer problems and shaping the product strategy through prioritization, delivery, launch, and measuring outcomes.

This role is ideal for a PM who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with customers and engineering teams, and turning complex business needs into simple, scalable product experiences. Areas may include business workflows, CRM, payments, integrations, data and analytics, platform services, AI-enabled capabilities, or other emerging platform opportunities.

**About the Team**  
The Flex Platform team operates through small, autonomous, cross-functional pods, with each pod accountable for a defined product area and outcome.

As the PM for your pod, you will be the primary product decision-maker, working closely with engineering, design, QA, architecture, and business stakeholders.

We believe PMs should own outcomes rather than simply manage backlogs. You will have the autonomy to determine what problem to solve, why it matters, what to build, and how to measure whether it worked.

**Key Position Responsibilities include:**  
**Product Discovery & Strategy**

* Understand customer, user, and business problems through research, data, and stakeholder insights.
* Define problems clearly before committing to solutions.
* Develop product hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed product trade-offs.
* Translate business strategy and customer needs into a clear product vision and roadmap for your area.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable platform capabilities that can scale across products, customers, and markets.

**Product Delivery**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog in partnership with engineering.
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Work closely with engineering, design, QA, and architecture throughout discovery and delivery.
* Make day-to-day product decisions and resolve ambiguity quickly.

title: Associate Manager, Product-Tech, Central
description:
**About The/Nudge Institute :**

**https://www.thenudge.org/** is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

  

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

  

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

**About this Role :**

The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.

**What will you do?**

* **Discover the problem:** Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* **Define the product:** Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* **Prioritise the roadmap:** Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* **Build with engineering and AI:** Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* **Test before release:** Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* **Launch and drive adoption:** Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* **Measure what matters:** Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* **Keep things documented:** Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* **Grow the product practice:** Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

  

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good to have:**

  

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:*** This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Service Consultant – Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)
description:
**About Us**

  

OLR is a specialist Oracle Retail systems integrator, trusted by leading retailers to deliver end-to-end merchandising, store and omnichannel solutions. We work across the Oracle Retail suite, delivering modernisation and cloud transformation programmes for leading retailers.

**OLR India** is the largest OLR delivery centre and a core pillar of OLR’s global operations. Based in Bangalore, India recently relocated to a new office at The Hive Workspaces, Prestige Tech Platina, the India team plays a critical role in delivering Oracle Retail implementations, upgrades, and 24/7 global support across all OLR regions. Our teams work closely with teams in Europe, North America and Latin America to provide end-to-end Oracle Retail systems integration, application support, and continuous optimisation for global retail operations.

Our Bangalore-based professionals are deeply involved in large-scale Oracle Retail implementations, cloud migrations, system upgrades, and omnichannel transformation programs, helping global retailers scale, modernise and remain future-ready in a rapidly evolving retail landscape.

**The Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Service Consultant – Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS)** to join our Application Maintenance and Support (AMS) team.

In this role, you will provide technical development and support for Oracle Retail applications, working on production issues, enhancements, interfaces, reports, and customisations. You will analyse requirements, develop and test solutions, troubleshoot technical issues, and maintain technical documentation to ensure the stability, quality, and performance of client applications.

You will collaborate with internal teams and clients across different locations, contributing to the successful delivery of technical solutions and ongoing application support.

**In this role, you’ll:**

  

* Analyse client requirements relating to data conversions, interfaces, reports, bolt-ons, and application enhancements within the technical framework of OLR projects and Oracle Retail products.
* Develop, customise, and maintain high-quality code to meet functional and technical requirements.
* Prepare and contribute to technical specifications based on functional requirements and other project documentation.
* Create and execute unit test plans for your own deliverables and, where required, those of other team members, ensuring solutions meet defined requirements and quality standards.
* Investigate and resolve technical defects and issues, following established tracking procedures and supporting the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Prepare and contribute to release notes and deployment packages, coordinating with team leads and project team members to support successful releases.
* Assist with effort estimation, preliminary requirements analysis, and technical solution planning.
* Work collaboratively within distributed teams, meeting agreed delivery timelines and reporting progress to team leads, development leads, onsite leads, and project managers.
* Participate in regular project meetings with local and remote colleagues, providing progress updates and discussing technical challenges. Some meetings may take place outside normal working hours.
* Travel occasionally to client sites or other OLR offices to support project delivery and collaborate with client and project teams.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or a related technical role, ideally within the retail industry or Retail IT.
* Previous experience in a consulting environment, working with clients and project teams.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle PL/SQL, including the development, debugging, and maintenance of database procedures and code.
* Good knowledge of Pro\*C and Unix shell scripting.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Retail Merchandising System (RMS), with familiarity with Retail Sales Audit (ReSA) and Retail Integration Bus (RIB).
* Experience analysing technical requirements, developing and testing solutions, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining technical documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues and deliver effective solutions.
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients and geographically distributed teams.
* Adaptability and a proactive approach to managing priorities and meeting project deadlines.

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Experience with Oracle Forms and Reports.
* Familiarity with BI Publisher (BIP) and Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE).
* Knowledge of Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM).
* Experience supporting or enhancing Oracle Retail applications in production environments.

**When you join us, you’ll:**

  

* Make a global impact by contributing to retail transformation projects across regions.

* Collaborate with international teams across UK, Portugal, US, Canada, Mexico, India.

* Grow your career through structured training, professional development, and career progression opportunities.

At OLR, we believe in supporting our people both professionally and personally. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

* Comprehensive health coverage with medical insurance for you and family

* Life & personal accident insurance

* Generous parental benefits: maternity and paternity leave

* Retirement benefits

title: Senior Product Manager - AI
description:
**Vacancy Name**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Vacancy No**

VN1077

  

**Job Title**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Work Location City**

Bangalore

  

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

  

**Preferred Experience Level**

7 years

  

**Preferred Education Level**

Master's Degree

  

**Employment Basis**

Full Time

  

**Benefits**

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

  

**Applications Close Date**

07 Apr 2027

title: Head of Workplace Identity & End User Computing
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the Role:**

  

The **Product Director, End User Computing & Identity** is accountable for the strategy, product direction, governance, and end-to-end lifecycle of Haleon’s workforce identity, access, endpoint, and virtual workplace capabilities. The role brings these services together as one integrated product portfolio, ensuring colleagues and partners can securely access the right applications, data, devices, and digital workspaces from the right location and at the right time.

The portfolio includes Active Directory, authentication and access services, joiner-mover-leaver enablement, privileged and conditional access integration, endpoint and mobile device management, standard device builds, application access and delivery, workplace security controls, virtual desktop and remote access services, and governance of workplace accessory policies. The role owns the product and technology lifecycle across these capabilities, from strategy and investment through design, engineering, adoption, service performance, modernisation, and retirement.

As Product Director, the role leads a multidisciplinary team of product, engineering, and service specialists and directs strategic partners. It works across Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Applications, HR, and business teams to deliver a coherent colleague experience, strengthen identity-led security, simplify the technology estate, and improve reliability, cost, and user experience at global scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and communicate the global vision, strategy, target architecture, roadmap, and investment priorities for Workplace Identity & End User Computing.

* Own the integrated product portfolio covering workforce identity, authentication, access, endpoints, device builds, application delivery, virtual desktops, and secure remote access.

* Provide end-to-end lifecycle ownership for Active Directory and cloud identity capabilities, ensuring resilient, scalable, and well-governed directory, authentication, federation, and access services.

* Partner with Cyber Security and application owners to embed identity-first and Zero Trust principles, including strong authentication, conditional access, least privilege, access recertification, and effective control of privileged access.

* Ensure identity and access services support efficient joiner, mover, and leaver journeys, role-based access, external-user access, and reliable integration with HR, SaaS, cloud, and enterprise applications.

* Own the endpoint and mobile product strategy and lifecycle across laptops, desktops, smartphones, tablets, shared devices, and specialist workplace endpoints, including procurement standards, enrolment, configuration, compliance, refresh, support, secure disposal, and oversight of workplace accessory policies and standards.

* Set the direction for modern endpoint management, standard device builds, operating system currency, patching, configuration, application packaging and deployment, endpoint security, and user experience.

* Own virtual desktop, application virtualisation, and remote access products, ensuring they provide secure, performant, and cost-effective access for employees, partners, specialist users, and regulated use cases.

* Create a seamless access experience across physical and virtual endpoints so that identity, device trust, application entitlement, and security policy operate as one coherent control framework.

* Maintain prioritised product roadmaps and backlogs, balancing colleague needs, security risk, regulatory obligations, resilience, technical debt, lifecycle exposure, cost, and strategic value.

* Define and track product outcomes and service measures covering user experience, adoption, access success, device compliance, service availability, security posture, lifecycle health, cost, and business value.

* Lead major modernisation, simplification, migration, and decommissioning initiatives across identity, endpoint, and virtual workplace technologies, with effective service transition and change adoption.

* Provide senior ownership of service health, major incidents, problem management, continuity, capacity, obsolescence, audit actions, and material risks across the portfolio.

* Manage strategic technology providers and delivery partners, setting clear outcomes and ensuring strong commercial control, licensing optimisation, performance, innovation, and accountability.

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team, establishing clear accountability, succession plans, capability development, and an inclusive product-led culture.

**About You**

  

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Significant senior leadership experience across enterprise workplace technology, identity and access, or end user computing within a large, complex, global organisation.

* Strong product and lifecycle management capability, with experience defining strategy, target state, roadmaps, investment cases, product outcomes, and service improvement priorities.

* Deep understanding of enterprise identity services, including Active Directory, cloud identity, authentication, federation, conditional access, role-based access, privileged access, and identity governance integration.

* Strong understanding of modern endpoint management, device build and provisioning, operating system and application lifecycle, patching, configuration, compliance, and endpoint security.

* Experience leading virtual desktop, application delivery, and secure remote access capabilities in a global enterprise environment.

* Proven ability to bring identity, device trust, application entitlement, and access controls together into a coherent user experience and security model.

* Experience leading multidisciplinary internal teams and strategic partners, with accountability for people development, service performance, delivery quality, and organisational capability.

* Strong commercial, financial, and supplier-management capability, including investment prioritisation, contract performance, licensing, demand, capacity, and cost optimisation.

* Excellent senior stakeholder leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence technology, cyber, HR, risk, and business leaders and make clear decisions across competing priorities.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and the wider Microsoft security and management ecosystem.

* Experience with enterprise virtual desktop and application delivery technologies such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or VMware platforms.

* Practical knowledge of Zero Trust, passwordless authentication, identity governance, privileged access management, endpoint detection and response, and security compliance frameworks.

* Experience simplifying global technology estates, modernising legacy identity or endpoint services, and delivering complex migrations with minimal business disruption.

* Relevant Microsoft, identity, cyber security, product management, architecture, or service management qualifications, with experience in regulated or high-risk environments.

**Join The Team!**

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior Ad Monetisation Manage to grow ad revenue across our portfolio while keeping players happy. Ads are a big part of our success story, and you’ll be writing the next chapter.

We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a hands-on owner who loves living in the mediation stack, spotting hidden revenue before anyone else, running smart tests and sharing the story behind every win.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Own ad revenue - set the ad monetisation strategy across our games, from mediation and bidding to network mix and geo strategy.
* Optimise every day - keep a close eye on eCPM, fill and ad performance across games, formats and geos, and act fast when things move.
* Design great ad experiences - work with product and producers on formats, placements and rewarded ads that players actually enjoy.
* Test, learn, repeat - run A/B tests with clear revenue goals and a watchful eye on retention.
* Be our revenue detective - catch misconfigurations and discrepancies early, and win that revenue back.
* Build strong partnerships - lead relationships with ad networks and mediation partners, and bring in new demand when it pays.
* Grow the team - guide and support our monetisation analysts.

### **What You’ll Own:**

**Ad revenue and ad LTV across our portfolio.** You’ll be the go-to owner of how our games earn from ads: keeping performance healthy, closing leaks fast, and turning every good idea into a tested win.

**How we’ll celebrate your success:**

* Ad revenue and ad ARPDAU against target.
* Revenue growth from tests you run.
* Healthy eCPM, fill, and impressions per user.
* Happy players: retention stays strong as revenue grows.

### **What You'll Bring:**

**Essential**

* Senior ad monetisation experience in F2P mobile games across multiple titles.
* Hands-on expertise with leading mediation platforms and in-app bidding.
* Strong analytical skills; comfortable with SQL or BI tools.
* Experience running ad A/B tests while protecting the player experience.
* An understanding of how ad LTV fuels UA.
* Confident in partner relationships and negotiations.
* Curious and proactive: you find the next pound of revenue before anyone asks.

**Desirable**

* Hybrid mobile game monetisation experience.
* Experience mentoring others.

### **Why Kwalee?**

* **Generous Holiday:** Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* **Flexible Working:** We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.

* **Gaming Goodies:** Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* **Transport:** Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* **Office Location:** Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* **Merch & Events:** Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

**About Upstox**
----------------

At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We're not just moving fast — we’re moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you're in the right place.

**The Role: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation**
-----------------------------------------------------

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you’ll own the top of this funnel — building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month.

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you’ll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

**Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management**

* **Lead management framework**: Design and own the end-to-end framework — sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads.

* **Ideal customer profile**: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data.

* **Outreach playbooks**: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events.

* **Renewal-cycle planning**: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates.

**Target Account List Building**

* **Target list**: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership.

* **Research & data tools**: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data.

* **Data hygiene & prioritisation**: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert.

**Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team**

* **Qualified pipeline**: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month.

* **Monthly targets**: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals.

* **Feedback loop**: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly.

**Team Leadership & Motivation**

* **Hiring & training**: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e.g., Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life).

* **Targets & reviews**: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards.

* **Coaching & culture**: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture.

**Individual Contribution**

* **Personal target**: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **CXO outreach**: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team.

* **Lead from the front**: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate.

**Tools, Reporting & Analytics**

* **Lead management stack**: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team.

* **Dashboards & MIS**: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement.

* **Data-led allocation**: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* **Collaboration**: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering.

**How Success Is Measured**
---------------------------

* **Qualified leads delivered**: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target.

* **Meetings held**: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker.

* **Funnel conversion**: Lead meeting proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel.

* **Team productivity**: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week.

* **Self-outreach target**: The Manager’s personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **Data quality**: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience leading a B2B SDR / lead generation team, with a proven track record of delivering monthly pipeline targets.

* Strong understanding of lead management: ICP definition, list building, qualification frameworks, lead scoring and sales handover.

* Hands-on with lead management and sales engagement tools — CRM, dialers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms.

* Excellent cold calling and outreach skills, with the confidence to engage CXO and HR leadership directly.

* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and retain a high-performing team.

* Data-driven, with comfort in building and reading dashboards and MIS.

* Excellent communication skills.

* Willing to work on-site from Bengaluru.

**Good to have**

* Experience in insurance, Employee Benefits or group health, or B2B selling to HR and Finance teams (e.g., HR-tech, payroll, fintech, SaaS).

* Familiarity with insurance distribution and the IRDAI regulatory environment.

* Graduate degree; MBA preferred.

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You’ll build the top of the funnel for a brand-new B2B Employee Benefits business at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms.

* You’ll have high ownership and visibility — your pipeline directly drives the revenue of the B2B insurance business.

* You’ll be a true player-coach, building a high-performing SDR team while leading from the front with CXOs.

* You’ll work with a passionate, fast-moving team across insurance, sales, marketing and product.

* Every corporate you bring in helps protect thousands of employees and their families.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice**, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI"). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Group Product Manager, Physical AI & Robotics
description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

**Location & Flexibility**
--------------------------

**India Hybrid: Bengaluru**
---------------------------

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a **Group Product Manager** for the **Physical AI Robotics product team**. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.

Your application will stand out if you are demonstrably curious and have side work projects to showcase.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* 8-12 years in product management, including at least 2 in robotics, physical AI, AR/VR, autonomous systems, or data collection at scale.
* Own the roadmap for robotics data collection, setting direction and driving execution across engineering, design, operations, quality, and solutions.
* Assess demand for new capture modalities, then define the collection model, hardware, and tooling.
* Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.
* Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.
* Translate customer model requirements into collection designs, and evolving research into quality standards for egocentric data: pose accuracy, sync tolerance, occlusion handling, annotation schema, acceptance criteria.
* Spend time with collectors, session leads, and reviewers. When data underperforms in training, trace it back to the capture design or the tooling that produced it.
* Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.
* Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.
* Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..
* Technical depth to hold a real conversation with a research team.
* Direct experience with one or more of: egocentric or wearable data capture, teleoperation systems, robot data pipelines, multi-sensor collection rigs or similar setups
* Experience defining product vision and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

* Hands-on robotics background. Robotics, ML engineer on embodied models, teleoperation engineer, or similar.
* Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, or manipulation policy training, and the data those methods need.
* Experience managing distributed human operations, including crowd or contractor workforces.
* You have shipped something physical and understand calibration, sensor sync, and coordinate frames, and how they fail.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team’s hybrid work schedule requirements.
  
  
Senior Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Team:** Customer Technology
  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
At Wayfair, we're working to make shopping more personal, relevant, and easier for millions of customers.
  
  
The Customer Understanding team builds the intelligence that helps Wayfair better understand what customers like, what they're looking for, and how their needs change over time. We turn customer behavior and signals into shared capabilities that power better search, recommendations, personalization, and shopping experiences.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, AI/ML, and customer experience, solving problems at scale and shaping how Wayfair understands and serves its customers.
  
  
Learn more about our technology teams on the[1] Wayfair Tech Blog.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Think big and work backwards from the customer:** Imagine what a great shopping experience could look like, identify gaps in how we understand customers, and define what we need to build.
  
  
**Shape strategy, not just a roadmap:** Challenge assumptions, solve ambiguous problems, and build a clear point of view on where to invest and why.
  
  
**Work at the cutting edge of AI/ML and data:** Partner with ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Platform teams to build scalable products, balancing model quality, performance, reliability, and cost.
  
  
**Connect technology to customer impact:** Work with Search, Recommendations, and other teams to turn customer intelligence into better shopping experiences, and validate the impact with experiments.
  
  
**See the bigger picture:** Connect opportunities across teams, customer journeys, and businesses. Bring fresh thinking from industry trends and advances in AI.
  
  
**Navigate complexity and drive progress:** Work across distributed teams with different priorities, build alignment, make trade-offs, and move things forward without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Own outcomes, not just delivery:** Take products from discovery to launch and adoption, measure real impact, and adapt based on what you learn.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
9+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  
  
Strong product thinking, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, and build a clear strategy.
  
  
Experience working with Engineering, Data Science, or ML teams on data-driven, platform, or algorithmic products.
  
  
Strong analytical skills and experience using customer insights, data, and experimentation to guide decisions.
  
  
Ability to understand technical concepts and trade-offs, while staying focused on customer problems and business outcomes.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially when working across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  
  
It's a Plus If You Have
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, personalization, search, recommendations, or customer data products.
  
  
Familiarity with customer embeddings, intent modeling, recommender systems, or cold-start personalization.
  
  
Experience building ML-powered products or reusable data and intelligence platforms.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager with experience building B2C consumer internet products. Someone who understands users, can identify the right problems to solve, and knows how to take a product from an idea to launch.

At FOXO, you'll work closely with founders, designers, engineers, and business teams to shape the product roadmap and turn business priorities into products that people find useful and want to keep using.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership, working through ambiguity, and being involved in every stage of product development, from understanding user needs to launching features and improving them based on feedback and data.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own product initiatives from discovery and planning to launch and ongoing improvements.
* Work with founders and leadership to define product priorities and build the roadmap.
* Speak to users, gather feedback, and use product data to understand what needs to improve.
* Turn business requirements and user problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Design and Engineering to build and ship products that are easy to use.
* Identify ways to improve user onboarding, conversion, engagement, and retention.
* Prioritise features based on user needs, business impact, and engineering effort.
* Define product metrics and track how features perform after launch.
* Run experiments and A/B tests to understand what works and what doesn't.
* Study user journeys and drop-off points to identify areas for improvement.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to keep product development and launches on track.
* Maintain clear documentation of product requirements, decisions, and workflows.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have:**

* 5–8 years of hands-on Product Management experience, with relevant experience in B2C consumer internet products.
* Experience building, launching, and improving consumer-facing digital products.
* A strong understanding of user behaviour, product discovery, and the product development lifecycle.
* Experience owning product roadmaps and taking initiatives from problem identification through execution.
* Comfort working with product analytics and customer feedback to make product decisions.
* Understanding of key product metrics such as activation, conversion, engagement, retention, and monetisation.
* Ability to write clear PRDs, user stories, product flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively.
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to take products from concept to launch.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work with different teams.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities can change and not every problem has an obvious answer.
* Ability to take ownership and drive projects independently.

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with consumer apps or high-growth B2C businesses.
* Experience building products from an early stage and scaling them as the user base grows.
* Exposure to AI-powered consumer products or AI/LLM-based features.
* Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or PostHog.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, and Notion.
* Working knowledge of SQL for analysing product data.

What Success Looks Like:

* Building products that address real user needs.
* Improving user adoption, engagement, and retention through meaningful product changes.
* Using customer feedback and data to decide what to build and what to improve.
* Taking ownership of product initiatives and delivering them with the team.
* Making thoughtful product decisions, learning from results, and improving the product over time.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Notice Period
* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Are you open to relocating to Bangalore?

description:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751141

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**The opportunity**

  

The product owner will be responsible for the technology analysis, end user research, future product planning, and cradle-to-grave life-cycle management of the product that is developed. You will build products from existing ideas, and help to develop new ideas based on your industry experience and your contact with customers and prospects. You must possess a unique blend of business and technical savvy; a big-picture vision, create a vision of the product from an end user perspective, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time in the market to understand their problems, and find innovative solutions for the broader market. You must be able to communicate with all areas of the company. You will work with a technology counterpart to define product release requirements. You will work closely with various stakeholders to make business decisions and create product strategies that ensure the long-term sustainability of the products or tools. You will also serve as the internal and external evangelist for your product offering, occasionally working with the sales channel and key customers.

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Identifying, evaluating, and planning new software products using lean/agile principles.
* Creating use-cases and related requirements materials for use by our development/technology teams
* Defining minimum viable product features (MVP) and/or pivoting existing products.
* Propose product strategy changes because of competitive changes in the marketplace.
* Working cross-functionally, define and drive alignment and implementation of the software roadmap including products, services, and solutions.
* Closely collaborate with cross-functional teams across business, technical and implementation teams to define product requirements to build and own the product roadmap.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog together with product management.
* Report to Global leadership on product status, management of budget etc.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of customers’ challenges and needs to clearly define product requirements
* Manage the product life cycle
* Assist in the build / buy strategy including recommendations for current solutions
* Communicate and drive organizational alignment on software deployment with key stakeholders including end users
* Works with the technology and client services teams to build and enhance products from existing ideas, and help develop new concepts based on industry research and the needs of end user

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Experience with HR / Payroll technology solutions and a good understanding of global HRIS / HR / Payroll technology landscape
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
* Ability to effectively work as a leader in a cross functional team environment including business and product development, supply chain and procurement processes and execution dependencies
* Strong track record of influencing successful product/solution vision/roadmap and executing to a plan
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and expertise in communicating with teams across geographies
* Excellent knowledge of Design Thinking and User Experience methodologies.
* Strategic thinker who is comfortable in a fast-paced, always-on, ambiguous start-up environment

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in engineering (Computer Science/ Technology
* 12 - 15 years of experience in IT/software industry with at least 6 years in capacity of product manager.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Knowledge and experience in dealing with cross platform mobile applications.
* Demonstrated success in delivering high quality technology products/services in a very high growth environment where priorities shift rapidly.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management

  

**What we offer**

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."
