Candidate profile (title) Who you are

Candidate profile (text) - Default language Are you passionate about coworker support and creating seamless service experiences across People & Culture processes? Do you enjoy understanding how services, workflows, knowledge, data, and systems connect end to end—and shaping ServiceNow HR Service Delivery solutions that work in practice? Are you motivated by simplifying how coworkers find information, request support, and receive timely, consistent help?
  
  
Are you someone who takes ownership, drives solutions forward, and collaborates across functions to make things happen?
  
  
If the answer is yes, keep reading—we might have the right role for you!
  
  
Our coworker support area plays a key role in ensuring that People & Culture services are easy to access, consistent, secure, and effective across processes and markets.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Owner to lead the ServiceNow HRSD within our People Platform. You will play a key role in shaping the roadmap, governance, and evolution of our core HR systems, ensuring secure, compliant, and seamless master data management across the employee lifecycle.
  
  
The role partners closely with People & Culture process owners, service delivery teams, Product Owners, and system engineers to translate needs across multiple processes into scalable product improvements, ensuring that solutions deliver business value and excellent coworker experience.
  
  
Furthermore, we believe that you bring:
  
  

* Strong understanding of coworker support and service delivery across multiple processes.
* Strong functional knowledge of ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD), including HR case and knowledge management.
* Experience with Employee Center, HR services and service catalogues, HR criteria, case templates, routing, or agent experiences.
* Knowledge of end-to-end People & Culture processes such as pay, benefits, mobility, absences, onboarding, transitions, and offboarding.
* Understanding of Agile product delivery methodologies.
* Ability to translate business and coworker needs into functional product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Knowledge of product lifecycle management and continuous product improvement.

* Awareness of data privacy, role-based access, and confidentiality requirements for sensitive People & Culture information.
* Proven experience owning and communicating a product roadmap, balancing business priorities, technical debt, and platform evolution.
* Ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, HR Process owners, security, and external vendors.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* 5–8 years of experience in Product Ownership of HR Technology with SAP SuccessFactors implementations.

* ServiceNow HRSD implementation, administration, or product ownership experience, including Employee Journey Management, Virtual Agent, NowAssist, analytics, or automation capabilities.
* Experience with large-scale, global People & Culture or enterprise service management implementations.

Key responsibilities (text) As Product Owner for ServiceNow HR Service Delivery you will own the strategic direction of the platform and ensure it continues to deliver value to HR, business users, and employees globally. You will work closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, HR Product teams, HR Process Owners and external vendors to continuously improve the platform while maintaining stability, compliance, and operational excellence.
  
  
This means you will:
  

* Work and communicate the product roadmap for ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD)
* Prioritize business requirements, platform enhancements, and operational stability in accordance with business needs.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to define and deliver scalable business solutions.
* Partner with HR and Product teams to translate business requirements into application capabilities.
* Ensure secure, compliant, and efficient employee data management across the entire employee lifecycle.
* Drive continuous improvements in core HR processes, workflows, automation, and user experience
* Support ServiceNow releases, Upgrades and transformation initiatives affecting the platform.
* Monitor platform health, operational KPIs, service quality, and user satisfaction

  
Beyond delivery, we expect you to:
  

* Take initiative and drive solutions forward independently
* Creating a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams
* Focus on real business value — not just delivery
* Continuously improving processes and ways of working
* Ensure solutions are trusted, relevant, and actively used.

  
We can offer you:
  

* The opportunity to shape how large-scale coworker support and People & Culture services are delivered and continuously improved through ServiceNow HRSD.
* A collaborative, cross-functional environment
* Opportunities to learn, grow, and work with modern ways of working
* A workplace that values ownership, simplicity, and continuous improvement

  
At IKEA we believe that we’re better when we’re physically together for collaboration, dialogues and conversations. We believe in the power of human interactions; informal chats, the energy, belonging and creativity generated by people being in the same place.
  
  
Our approach is that we spend majority of our time in the IKEA workplace and with flexibility to work from home when relevant.

Team vision ( title) Together as a team

Team vision (text) We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others

* Having fun!

**OVERVIEW**
------------

APEXX is an **independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.** Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: **acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.** Our **routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.** We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by **MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital** and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including **Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an **Engineering Operations Lead** to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
------------------------

### **Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:** take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:** establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:** connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:** oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:** troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

### **Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:** establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:** develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:** coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:** track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:** strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:** translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:** identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

### **AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:** develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:** explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:** strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:** reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:** evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

* Strong experience in **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role** within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving **Jira**, including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with **engineering performance metrics**, including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting** to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**, constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Experience working within a **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management** function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**, ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**
---------------

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges — improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
---------------------------

* **Competitive compensation:** that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:** annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:** up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy.
* **Comprehensive health insurance:** for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:** for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:** enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:** opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**
-----------------------------

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to **200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.** We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

title: Pod Lead Engineer
description:
Req ID: 59712

Job Function: Software Engineering

Posting Start Date: 19/10/2026

Posting End Date: 19/10/2026

Division: Digital

Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**About the role**
------------------

The Pod Lead Engineer is a hands‑on software engineering specialist who leads a small, outcome‑focused delivery pod of 4–5 Pod Engineers. The role combines deep technical contribution with day‑to‑day pod leadership, enabling faster delivery through AI‑assisted / AI‑orchestrated SDLC practices.
  
Unlike a traditional team lead role, the Pod Lead Engineer operates in an AI‑native delivery model where AI tools and agents are used across the SDLC to accelerate requirements, design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release readiness. The Pod Lead Engineer contribute to technical direction, delivery execution, and engineering quality, while maintaining high standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**1) Hands‑On Delivery Leadership (Core)**  

* Lead a 4–5 engineer pod by building software alongside the team, taking ownership of design, coding, reviews, and integration while breaking work into small, deliverable increments using modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automation, code quality gates).
* Drive frequent delivery of working software by ensuring clear definitions of done, measurable progress, and strong accountability for end‑to‑end delivery outcomes.

**2)AI‑Enabled SDLC Execution**  

* Embed AI across SDLC stages (requirements, design, build, test, deploy, operate) to accelerate solution design, safely generate/refactor code, create tests/automation, and support reviews and documentation.
* Establish pod‑level practices to maximize productivity with clear human accountability for decisions and release readiness, while maintaining required gates (e.g., quality checks, approvals) aligned to organizational standards.

**3)Technical Direction & Engineering Quality**  

* Act as the pod’s technical authority, defining architecture (within guardrails), patterns, component design, and integration approach.
* Own code quality, maintainability, performance, reliability, and security, while establishing pod‑level engineering standards (branching, coding conventions, reviews, CI/CD hygiene).

**4)Pod Management (Small Team Leadership)**  

* Provide day‑to‑day leadership for a 4–5 engineer pod, including task allocation, pairing strategy, prioritization, and removing blockers.
* Coach engineers in AI‑native ways of working (prompting, evaluation, safe AI use) while driving continuous improvement through retrospectives, root cause analysis, and measurable cycle‑time and quality gains.

**5)Stakeholder Alignment & Outcome Ownership**  

* Partner with the Senior Manager, AI Engineering and business/product stakeholders to clarify outcomes, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, translating needs into clear technical milestones and deliverable increments.
* Provide transparent updates on progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions to ensure strong alignment and end‑to‑end outcome ownership.

**6)Governance, Risk, and Responsible Engineering**  

* Ensure adherence to security, data protection, and engineering governance standards while proactively managing risks from AI‑assisted development (e.g., licensing, security vulnerabilities, hallucinated code, weak tests).
* Maintain required auditable artefacts (documentation, traceability, approvals) aligned with enterprise expectations for controlled delivery.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Strong experience as a senior software engineer / technical lead / engineering specialist delivering production systems.
* Solid engineering fundamentals: API design (REST), data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD, secure coding, reliability practices.
* Expertise in Java or .NET or Python along with UI and backend technologies like React, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Neptune DB.
* Strong credentials in Cloud environments like AWS.
* Experience leading small delivery groups (e.g., squad/pod/team) and delivering iteratively.
* Practical experience using AI development tools (Copilot, Amazon Kiro, Claude Code, agent workflows, automated test generation, AI‑assisted documentation).

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience working in AI‑assisted / agentic delivery models or rapid delivery “pods” / cohort models.
* Familiarity with governance practices with quality and assurance in delivery environments (e.g., gate reviews, readiness checks).

title: Associate Manager, Product Planning and Adoption, EIP
description:
**Place of Posting -** Bengaluru

**Team :** Economic Inclusion Program

**About The/Nudge :**

**https://www.thenudge.org/** is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

**What are we solving for?**

We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.

At The/Nudge Institute, we have been piloting this program for the past 3 years and are now scaling it across multiple states. Our purpose is to enable the most excluded individuals to become contributing members of the economy. We will :

  

* Enable government to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
* Continue to iterate on the program design to create impact at scale through our own implementations
* Support more NGOs in adopting graduation approach by offering technical expertise and capacity building
* Build evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
* Develop technology solutions that enable NGOs and governments to adopt and implement the program at scale & with quality

**Position Overview :**

**What are some of the principles/ approaches we use?**

  

* https://fs.blog/first-principles/
* Human centered design (thoughtful, action oriented, experimental & iterative process) with a gender lens (unbiased and reflective approach)
* Systems thinking (analytical, stakeholder oriented and holistic)
* Strategic planning (result oriented, logical & coherent with clearly defined outcomes, grounded in current realities)

**What will you do?**

We are hiring an Associate Manager, Product Planning Feedback and Adoption to independently own planning, adoption and feedback workstreams across multiple state programs. The person will translate program priorities into measurable plans, ensure that product interventions and tools are used effectively, and build feedback loops that turn field experience into product and operating improvements.

This role combines hands-on program management with analytical and strategic ownership. The Associate Manager will work closely with State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights, Livelihood, Learning and Development, and program leadership. The role requires the ability to facilitate decisions, identify risks early and drive actions to closure with limited supervision.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Planning and program visibility**
  + Strengthen governance. Design weekly, fortnightly and monthly review rhythms that result in clear decisions, owners and next steps.
  + Strengthen collaboration between State Operation teams and Central Product teams through a regular cadence.
* **Adoption and data driven action**
  + Own adoption across states. Lead the adoption of product interventions and tools from rollout through sustained and meaningful use.
  + Define meaningful metrics. Establish metric definitions, data sources, reporting frequency and data quality checks.
  + Interpret performance. Analyse trackers and dashboards, segment gaps by state, block, cohort or tool, and distinguish process, product and data issues.
  + Convert insights into action. Develop state-specific recommendations, align owners and timelines, and monitor whether interventions improve adoption.
* **Feedback systems and product improvement**
  + Design end to end feedback cycles. Define the milestone, respondents, sampling approach, questions, scoring logic and success measures.
  + Ensure reliable data collection. Coordinate with state teams, monitor response quality and resolve collection gaps without compromising timelines.
  + Synthesize field evidence. Combine quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear product and process recommendations prioritised by impact, urgency and feasibility.
  + Close the feedback loop. Track accepted actions with owners and timelines, communicate decisions to stakeholders and verify closure.
* **Stakeholder leadership and communication**
  + Anchor cross-functional forums. Set the agenda, prepare concise pre-reads, facilitate the discussion and keep reviews focused on decisions and actions.
  + Influence without authority. Build alignment across State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights and domain teams, and escalate dependencies with context and options.
  + Create leadership visibility. Prepare scorecards, reviews and written updates that explain progress, risks, underlying causes and specific asks.
  + Raise execution standards. Guide team members and partners on data discipline, meeting preparation, documentation and follow-through.

**What success looks like:**

Success in this role means that program plans and adoption metrics are trusted and used in reviews; risks are surfaced early with clear recovery plans; state and product teams receive recommendations that improve adoption; and field feedback leads to prioritised, tracked and communicated product or process improvements.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* **Experience and education**
  + Relevant experience. 6+ years in program management, product operations, strategy and operations, implementation consulting or large-scale operations.
  + Independent ownership. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional, multi-location or multi-state workstreams from planning through closure.
  + Education. A postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred. Candidates with a bachelor's degree and strong relevant experience will also be considered.
* **Core capabilities:**
  + Analytical fluency. Can define and interpret metrics, question data quality, identify patterns and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
  + Structured problem solving. Can break down ambiguous problems, identify root causes, evaluate options and make sound recommendations.
  + Stakeholder management. Can build credibility, navigate differing priorities and influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.
  + Executive communication. Can facilitate effective meetings and communicate complex information clearly in written and verbal formats.
  + Execution discipline. Is organized, detail-oriented and proactive about follow-ups, risks and escalation while managing multiple priorities.
  + Tools. Is proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with dashboards and presentation tools.
  + Language and travel. Has strong written and spoken English and Hindi, and is willing to travel to and stay in rural program locations when required.
* **Good to have:**
  + Sector experience. Exposure to livelihoods, social impact programs, government systems or large-scale field implementation.
  + Product adoption. Experience driving adoption of digital tools or process interventions across distributed teams.
  + Research and feedback. Experience with survey design, qualitative research, feedback synthesis or user research.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Design Lead - Bangalore, India
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**

*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

**About**
---------

In 1931, an engineering draughtsman named Harry Beck redrew the map of the London Underground. He ignored geography, distorted distance, and reduced the world's most complicated transit system to something anyone could read. Beck understood that when a system gets complex enough, accuracy isn't the same thing as truth. The designer's job is to make the complex legible — so people can decide where to go.  
  
**The role**

Bangalore is one of WisdomAI's largest and fastest-growing engineering hubs, and much of our platform is built there. We're hiring a Design Lead to be a core design partner to that team: owning major product areas, setting the craft bar on everything that ships from Bangalore, and growing into the office's design manager as the team grows.

The work spans our whole platform. Chat on Data, Live Apps, our Slack and Teams apps, MCP, our visualizations, and a major push into agents: always-on teammates for the enterprise, grounded in Wisdom's context engine. Every one of these has to feel like the same product, built by the same hands.

**Design at WisdomAI**
----------------------

**Craft is the product.** People make real decisions from what we show them. A chart that's technically correct but visually misleading is a failure. An answer that's right but illegible is a failure. Craft isn't decoration here. It's the product working.

**AI-native by default.** Exploration often starts in an LLM — clarifying intent, mapping edge cases, pressure-testing a direction before a single frame exists. We prototype in code, move fluidly between Claude, Cursor, Paper, and Figma, and aren't precious about toolchain. We optimize for velocity and quality.

**Small and senior, on purpose.** With today's AI tools, a handful of exceptional designers can have outsized impact. Everyone here owns real territory, and the team grows only when the bar stays this high. You'll work alongside a designer in Bangalore and the design team in San Mateo, directly with our VP of Design.

**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

* **Coherence across the platform.** Think in systems from the context engine outward, so a definition, an answer, a chart, or an agent behaves the same way in chat, in Slack, in a Live App, and over MCP.
* **Agents.** Define what a great enterprise agent feels like: how it takes on work, reports back, earns trust, asks before acting, and shows up where people already work.
* **Live Apps.** Customers build anything here: a daily brief that reads like the New York Times, a pricing simulator with deep sensitivity analysis, a dashboard on steroids, a mobile metric tracker. You'll design the best of them, and the templates and primitives that let everyone else build their own — for apps and for agents.
* **The context engine.** Make a deep, powerful layer of semantics, definitions, and governance legible to the people who configure it and the people who rely on it.
* **Data visualization, occasionally.** Our charts are a signature of the product. You'll pick up visualization work from time to time.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own product areas end to end, from customer discovery and problem framing with PMs and engineers through launch and iteration.
* Work side by side with engineers every day. Make design a fast, natural part of how Bangalore builds, not a handoff.
* Prototype early and often with AI tools, building working things rather than static frames, then carry validated concepts through full state coverage and system alignment.
* Set the craft bar in crits and in what ships. Share prompts, patterns, and process with the team.
* Extend our design system so new surfaces arrive coherent by default.
* Partner closely with design leadership in San Mateo across time zones, and help hire and grow the Bangalore design team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 7+ years designing products, with a body of work in complex B2B, data, analytics, AI, or developer tools.
* A high bar for craft — visual, UI, and interaction. You notice the 1px things, and you know which ones matter.
* Impeccable taste, and opinions you can explain and defend.
* Sharp product thinking and a talent for taming complexity: you find the simple model hiding inside a sprawling system.
* A systems mind. You've driven coherence across many surfaces, not just polished a single flow.
* You work AI-natively today. You design with LLMs and AI prototyping or coding tools daily, and you can show how they've changed your work.
* You've mentored other designers and earned the trust of engineering teams, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------

* You code, or consider yourself one part design engineer.
* An interest in data visualization. Experience is welcome but not required.
* You've designed agentic experiences, or templates and systems that other people build with.
* A background in data visualization or analytics.
* Experience on product teams that work across the US and India.

-

**Our CRAFT**

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

**C — Customer trust.** Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

**A — Authenticity.** We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

**T — Transparency.** We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

-

**Equal opportunity employer**

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

description:

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in release management, change management, platform operations, software delivery, or related technology disciplines, including responsibility for coordinating enterprise production releases across complex technology environments.- Proven experience managing releases across cloud, data, or software platforms, working across multiple teams, environments, dependencies, and stakeholder groups while balancing competing priorities and ensuring successful delivery outcomes.- Strong technical understanding of modern data platform technologies, including Snowflake, Azure, Matillion, dbt, and Apache Airflow, with the ability to assess deployment dependencies, operational impacts, and production risks.- Hands-on knowledge of modern software delivery and change-control practices, including GitHub Enterprise or comparable source-control platforms, CI/CD methodologies, branching and promotion strategies, automated testing, deployment approvals, rollback procedures, and IT service management/change processes using ServiceNow or equivalent tools, including standard, normal, and emergency changes.- Exceptional planning, facilitation, documentation, risk management, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple releases, translate complex technical release information into concise status, readiness, risk, and decision communications for both engineering teams and executive leadership; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:**

* Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and occasionally internationally for team meetings, planning workshops, vendor engagements, and OpCo collaboration.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Release management for regulated or audit-sensitive platforms under SOX, SOC 1/2, GxP, privacy, or similar control frameworks.
* GitOps, reusable GitHub Actions workflows, automated quality gates, artifact versioning, and progressive delivery practices.
* Data platform observability, incident management, problem management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness.
* Coordinating releases in a multi-OpCo, multi-tenant, or federated enterprise environment.
* Certifications such as ITIL 4, SAFe, Scrum.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Leads complex product management work, programs, projects, or initiatives across a broad area of responsibility in alignment with product, departmental, functional, and business objectives.  
2. Translates business plans, client needs, product priorities, and functional objectives into actionable recommendations, work plans, and execution approaches.  
3. Provides subject matter expertise on complex products, processes, services, or product life-cycle activities, advising stakeholders on risks, opportunities, dependencies, and potential solutions.  
4. Partners with senior functional leaders, business line stakeholders, Legal, regulatory contacts, and cross-functional partners to interpret business challenges, align priorities, and support strategic and operational decision-making.  
5. Identifies and resolves complex product, process, operational, or client-related issues by analyzing information from multiple sources, applying sound judgment, and leveraging appropriate resources within and outside the function.  
6. Recommends and implements best practices, product enhancements, service improvements, and process changes that strengthen efficiency, quality, control effectiveness, and business outcomes.  
7. Leads or contributes to high-impact initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination, influence, change management, and execution discipline across the product life cycle.  
8. Uses data, metrics, reporting, market or client insights, and performance information to guide decisions, evaluate outcomes, and identify improvement opportunities.  
9. Develops and maintains strong strategic working relationships with peers, senior staff, functional partners, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and sustained performance.  
10. Serves as a technical or functional resource for colleagues by sharing expertise, providing guidance on complex matters, and supporting consistent execution of product-related work.  
11. Performs all duties according to established policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS**

* Specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise in own discipline or field, with the ability to apply that expertise to complex product management work.
* Strong business acumen and ability to interpret internal and external business challenges to recommend best practices, product enhancements, or process improvements.
* Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate collaboration or escalation.
* Ability to influence outcomes, negotiate change, and guide stakeholders across areas of responsibility without direct people management authority.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to advise senior functional management and build strategic relationships across the function.
* Experience leading complex initiatives, coordinating cross-functional work, and maintaining execution discipline across multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Knowledge of product management activities, operational processes, controls, risk considerations, and product life-cycle requirements within the area of responsibility.
* Ability to use data, metrics, reporting, and performance information to guide recommendations, measure outcomes, and improve product or process effectiveness.

**EDUCATION/ EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor’s/University degree required; advanced degree preferred. Typically 8+ years of relevant experience, including experience managing complex products, processes, programs, or initiatives; advising stakeholders on product-related matters; and influencing cross-functional outcomes in alignment with business objectives.

**Eligibility - Internal Partners**

  

* 2 years as Senior Consultant/Associate Specialist/Section Manager/Operations Manager to move as a Specialist
* 1 year as Division Manager to move as a Specialist

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751424

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **Senior Full Stack .NET Developer**

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**The opportunity**

The individual will play the role of a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer in designing, building, and deploying secure, scalable, and user-centric enterprise applications within the Technology Transformation team.

The role will require working closely with Managers, Product Owners, Architects, UX, QA, and business stakeholders. It will involve developing modern web applications using .NET and front-end frameworks, integrating enterprise services and data sources, and working with AI capabilities where relevant.

The objective of this role is to deliver production-grade digital solutions that simplify business processes, improve user experience, and create measurable value. GenAI and AI integration experience will be an added advantage.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Designing, developing, testing, and maintaining end-to-end enterprise web applications using .NET technologies and modern front-end frameworks
* Translating business and functional requirements into scalable application architecture, technical designs, APIs, data models, and user experiences
* Building backend services and RESTful APIs using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Entity Framework Core
* Developing responsive and reusable user interfaces using Angular or React, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI component libraries
* Designing and optimizing relational database objects, queries, and data-access components using SQL Server or equivalent databases
* Integrating applications with enterprise and third-party systems using REST APIs, JSON, Microsoft Graph, messaging, or event-driven patterns
* Implementing secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and role-based access control
* Applying clean architecture, SOLID principles, design patterns, and coding standards to build maintainable and extensible solutions
* Writing unit, integration, and automated tests, and participating in peer reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Building and supporting CI/CD pipelines and deploying applications to cloud environments
* Collaborating with product, UX, QA, data, infrastructure, security, and domain teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Guiding and reviewing the work of junior developers and contributing to technical standards, reusable components, and knowledge sharing
* Integrating GenAI or AI services into applications, where applicable, such as conversational interfaces, document processing, intelligent search, summarization, classification, or assisted workflows
* Ensuring solutions meet enterprise expectations for security, privacy, logging, monitoring, resilience, and supportability

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, and Entity Framework Core
* Hands-on experience with at least one modern front-end framework, preferably Angular or React, along with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3
* Strong understanding of full-stack application design, RESTful APIs, JSON, OpenAPI / Swagger, and API security
* Experience with SQL Server, database design, stored procedures, query optimization, and object-relational mapping
* Sound understanding of object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, design patterns, data structures, and algorithms
* Experience with unit testing and mocking frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Moq, or equivalent tools
* Working experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD practices
* Working experience with at least one cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure
* Experience troubleshooting production issues using application logs, telemetry, and monitoring tools
* Good understanding of secure coding, performance, scalability, accessibility, and responsive design
* Exposure to GenAI concepts and the integration of AI services or LLM-based capabilities into enterprise applications will be an added advantage
* Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, prompt design, or AI-assisted development tools is desirable

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline
* 5-8 years of software engineering experience, including strong hands-on experience in full-stack .NET application development
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise web applications to production
* Hands-on experience across backend services, front-end development, databases, system integration, testing, and deployment
* Experience contributing to reusable frameworks, components, accelerators, or engineering standards
* Ability to independently own technical workstreams and collaborate effectively with distributed teams and stakeholders

  

**Ideally, you'll also have**

Hands-on experience with Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, API Management, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS, microservices, event-driven architecture, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines will be an added advantage. Microsoft Azure, .NET, cloud, DevOps, security, or AI certifications are preferred.

  

**What we look for**

* Self-motivated individual with ownership of assigned workstreams and the ability to work independently
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to translate requirements into practical and sustainable technical solutions
* Clear communication with both technical and business stakeholders
* Commitment to engineering quality, continuous learning, collaboration, and mentoring
* Ability to balance delivery timelines with security, maintainability, user experience, and long-term product needs

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. title: Product Manager
description:
LocationSan Francisco, Bangalore, or Seattle

Employment typeFull-time

Location typeIn-person

DepartmentProduct

Commenda is building the agent for global legal and tax work. Teams use it to register entities, manage obligations, and stay compliant globally. Today that work requires additional headcount, local vendors, and disconnected systems.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn complex legal, tax, and operational work into reliable, agentic products. You’ll define how agents use company context, interpret requirements, take action, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You’ll work directly with customers, engineers, domain experts, and operations to build products that deliver compliance outcomes.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

**Build agents that get compliance work done.** Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

**Make agent behavior measurable and reliable.** Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios and edge cases. You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

**Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior.** Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

**Build and improve workflows yourself.** Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

**Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together.** Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

**Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize.** Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **At least two years of product management experience**, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
* **Hands-on experience with AI evaluations.** You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
* **Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.** These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
* **Strong judgment about agentic user experiences.** You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
* **Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence.** You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
* **Strong ownership and organizational skills.** You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
* **A willingness to get into the details.** You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
* **Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel.** You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
* **Curiosity and rigor in complex domains.** You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

**About the team**
------------------

We’re an ambitious, intense team spread across Bangalore, San Francisco, and Seattle. We work like a sports team: we practice, challenge each other, and take shared responsibility for winning. People here move quickly, form their own opinions, and take on problems without waiting to be assigned them.

AI is part of how we build every day. You’ll work alongside engineers and domain experts who use agents to tackle complex work, experiment with new tools, and push what the product can do. We value curiosity, imagination, and the willingness to turn an unconventional idea into something customers can use.

You’ll have real ownership early, direct access to the people making decisions, and room to grow as you prove what you can take on.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Health insurance.
* A monthly self-improvement stipend for learning, fitness, or other investments in your development.
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration with colleagues across our global offices.
* A collaborative office environment and team events.

------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an Associate Director in Financial Institutions Group, India, you will play an active role in driving a customer-centric, solutions-led and fast-growing FIG franchise. The role carries responsibility for client coverage, origination, portfolio management and execution activities, while contributing to revenue growth, risk discipline and high-quality client outcomes.

  

This is an independent Relationship Manager role with meaningful commercial accountability and exposure to client coverage in an Institutional setting. The role would suit a technically strong banker with sound commercial judgement, clear communication skills and the ability to contribute to origination, execution discipline, revenue delivery and portfolio growth. Understanding of relationship management, credit risk, key products and compliance is highly desirable

  

Financial Institutions Group (FIG) is a global business which entails tapping and optimising opportunities emanating from and into our global and regional clients and initiatives. It comprises Banks, Diversified Financials (DF), Insurance and Funds segments.

  

FIG India is part of the FIG South East Asia, India and Middle East (SEAIME) region and covers all the four FIG segments. The business offers its clients a wide range of products including clearing, FX, derivatives, precious metal sales, syndicated and bilateral loans, trade and debt capital markets.

  

FIG India is a growing business with a track record of prudent risk management, quality client coverage and superior returns.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

Role Location: Altimus, Mumbai

Role Type: Permanent

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

* Client Coverage: Take primary coverage responsibility for a portfolio of clients, while shadowing senior banker/s on strategic relationships. Develop a strong understanding of client priorities, decision-makers, wallet opportunities, and near-term revenue potential.
* Origination & Revenue Delivery: Support the origination of new business opportunities across the FIG portfolio, including identifying transaction ideas, maintaining an active pipeline, tracking deal conversion and contributing to revenue targets for the business.
* Portfolio Growth & Business Planning: Account planning, client prioritization and portfolio growth initiatives, including revenue budgeting, pipeline reviews, wallet analysis and preparation of business performance updates.
* Strategy and Planning: Contribute to FIG India’s strategic priorities through sector research, target client analysis, data-led insights and preparation of senior management presentations.
* Special Projects and Campaigns: Lead or support priority campaigns and special projects such as targeted segment campaigns, including financial sponsor banking initiatives.
* Information Management: Maintain accurate and actionable business information across revenue, pipeline, client activity and portfolio metrics to support timely decision-making.
* Transactional Support: Support transaction execution, documentation and client servicing in partnership with product, legal, risk, operations and support teams.
* Know Your Customer (KYC) & Customer Readiness: Ensure timely and thorough completion of inbound and outbound KYC for the portfolio, streamline the KYC process and ensure customers are deal-ready for key products and geographies.
* Risk & Compliance Assurance: Support disciplined business growth by ensuring activities are managed within applicable risk, compliance and governance standards.
* Product Exposure: Develop and

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* A commercially minded team player who strives for excellence and demonstrates ownership of client and business outcomes working in a fast paced International bank.
* Ability to form effective working relationships with clients, senior bankers, product partners and internal stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving ability, growth mindset and capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Good verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear client materials and senior management updates.
* High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly around pipeline, revenue, portfolio, KYC and transaction information.
* Graduate qualification in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 8-10 years of experience as a FIG Relationship Manager in banking.
* Experience with coverage of Indian Financial Sponsors and NBFCs will be considered positively.
* Understanding of origination processes, risk management and compliance requirements.
* Thorough understanding of banking regulation and local market nuances including Gift City.
* Understanding of the credit and documentation principles.
* Proficiency in computers, especially Co-Pilot, Microsoft Excel, word and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical capability to review client, portfolio, pipeline and revenue information and translate it into actionable insights

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

Candidate profile (text) - Default language Are you passionate about Digital workplace, Employee Communication, collaboration & Productivity and how it creates business value? Do you enjoy understanding how our tools helps our coworkers with simplified experience and boost productivity? Are you someone with a genuine interest in how Communication & Collaboration business can be improved through smart use of technology and processes?
  
  
Are you someone who takes ownership, drives solutions forward, and collaborates across functions to make things happen?
  
  
If the answer is yes, then keep reading—we might have the right role for you!
  
  
Our Digital Workplace – Communication & Collaboration plays a key role in ensuring that Digital Products & Services works effectively for the business.
  
  
We are now looking for a Product Specialist to take ownership and drive development within this area. In this role, you will ensure that our sub domain supports how we operate within IKEA’s technology-process-delivery ecosystem.
  
  
You will work closely with Product owners, Engineers, project managers, end-users, and cross-functional teams to understand needs, translate them into solutions, and drive adoption across the organization.
  
You bring strong communication skills and thrive in both technical and business discussions. You understand how to identify gaps, design solutions, and ensure that systems evolve with the business. Above all, you take ownership, show initiative, and are driven to deliver solutions that create real impact.

Key responsibilities (title) What you'll need to have

Key responsibilities (text) A Product Specialist for Communication, Collaboration & Productivity tools should ideally have skills across five areas:
  
  

* 6+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft 365 Products and solutions
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* A proactive mindset with strong ownership and problem-solving ability
* Track record of working in a similar role and delivering impactful results
* Product management
* Microsoft 365 expertise (technical skills)
* Adoption & Change
* Analytics & Reporting

Technical skills
  

* Microsoft Teams
* SharePoint Online
* OneDrive
* Outlook
* Planner
* Teams Rooms
* Teams Telephony
* Microsoft Project
* Visio
* Viva solutions
* Copilot

Change management and adoption:
  

* Prosci/ADKAR concepts (good-to-have)
* Communication planning
* Training design
* Champion networks
* Adoption campaigns
* Resistance management
* Executive sponsorship engagement

Analytics and reporting:
  

* Power BI basics
* Adoption reporting
* Usage analytics
* KPI dashboards

Team vision (text) We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

Let's connect A day in your life with us

Let´s connect As a Product Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring that the Communication & Collaboration sub domain delivers value to the business and supports efficient, data-driven decision-making.
  
You will take ownership of your area, continuously improving it by aligning capabilities with business needs. You will work hands-on with below key products ensuring solutions support how we actually operate.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across business, Product owners, Partners, project managers, end-users, and cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment and driving adoption.
  
  
This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, where your work directly impacts the delivery of high-quality solutions, technological advancements, and the organization's growth and efficiency.
  
  
To be concrete, you will:
  
  

* Measure, analyze and report on the performance of the Digital Products against business goals and KPIs
* Responsible for all product related analysis, utilizing both customer and product data
* Support the product owner in tactical decision making with analysis results and insights
* Supporting the Product Owner in writing user stories
* To develop extensive knowledge of the stakeholders’ (Product Manager & other business stakeholders)
* needs and interpret and share that knowledge with the product team, providing context, as needed to
* ensure what they develop and deliver what is expected
* To test, analyze and validate the actual impact of the product to make sure the product reaches its goals
* Where needed, (and directed by the Product Manager/Owner) work with co-workers to understand and
* quantify their needs and requirements, ensuring they are included and integrated into the product as
* needed
* Work cross functional to ensure that the agile team has what is needs and remove blockers that prevent
* the agile team to maximize the delivery of digital products

Beyond delivery, we expect you to:
  
  

* Take initiative and drive solutions forward independently
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams
* Focus on real business value — not just delivery
* Continuously improve processes and ways of working
* Ensure solutions are trusted, relevant, and actively used

  
We can offer you
  
  

* Opportunity to shape how Communication & Collaboration area in Digital workplace is developed and improved
* A collaborative, cross-functional environment
* Opportunities to learn, grow, and work with modern ways of working
* A workplace that values ownership, simplicity, and continuous improvement

  
At IKEA we believe that we’re better when we’re physically together for collaboration, dialogues and conversations. We believe in the power of human interactions; the informal chats, the energy, belonging and creativity generated by people being in the same place.
  
  
Our approach is that we spend majority of our time in the IKEA workplace and with flexibility to work from home when relevant.

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

About the Company

Aryupay Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a technology-driven company focused on delivering innovative digital solutions. We are looking for a results-oriented Ad Manager to plan, execute, and optimize advertising campaigns to support our business growth.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Ad Manager with strong expertise in digital advertising, paid marketing campaigns, budget management, and performance analysis. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing effective advertising strategies, managing multiple ad platforms, and maximizing ROI through data-driven decisions.

* Plan, create, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), and other relevant platforms.

* Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and optimize performance within defined budgets.
* Knowledge of A/B testing, lead generation, and conversion optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing advertising campaigns for technology, fintech, or digital product companies.
* Google Ads or Meta Blueprint certifications.
* Experience in lead generation and customer acquisition campaigns.

* Opportunity to work with a growing technology company.
* Exposure to diverse digital marketing campaigns and strategies.

Overview

Bangalore, India

**2. GENERAL JOB SUMMARY**

  

The Personalisation Specialist builds and launches personalised experiences for Aptean.com using Optimizely and the Optimizely Data Platform (ODP). The role turns approved specifications into live, measured experiences that match content to visitor characteristics, campaign context and on-site behaviour, helping improve quality, speed and pipeline impact.

**3. SCOPE**

  

Supports a roadmap of more than 50 personalised experiences across Aptean.com, including industry-based redirects, ad-to-page message matching, personalised forms, trust signals and slide-in panels. The role owns hands-on build, audience configuration, experimentation setup, quality assurance, launch monitoring, measurement and documentation for assigned experiences, while coordinating reviews with marketing, analytics, development, design, brand, product marketing and legal stakeholders.

**4. ORGANIZATION**

  

Reports directly to the Web Content and Optimisation Director within Aptean's global Digital Marketing team and collaborates with the CRO Lead, Digital Analyst, product marketing, web development and design teams.

**5. PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Build personalised page variants and experiences in Optimizely from approved specifications, including copy, layout, proof and calls to action.

* Create and maintain audience segments in ODP using signals such as industry, persona, traffic source, campaign and on-site behaviour, and check for segment overlap.

* Set up rules that match landing pages to paid media, campaign and referral traffic, including a complete default page for visitors who cannot be placed in a segment.

* Configure experiments with holdouts, check sample size and duration before launch, and apply frequency caps and suppression rules.

* Test every experience across browsers and devices before launch and validate that tracking and conversion events fire correctly.

* Launch experiences according to the roadmap schedule, monitor them after launch and flag issues quickly.

* Report results against the holdout and document each experience as ship, iterate or stop so learnings carry into the next wave.

* Collaborate with the CRO Lead, Digital Analyst, product marketing, web developers and design, and route copy through brand, product marketing and legal review.

* Maintain clear records of every live experience, including its audience, rules and status.

**6. JOB SPECIFICATIONS**

  

**Education**

  

**Required**

**Preferred**

**Degree / Certification**

Bachelor's degree

Master's degree

Ph.D.

J.D. (law)

Certification

Registration

Licensure

Other

  

**Work Experience**

Hands-on experience building experiments or personalised experiences in Optimizely or a comparable tool such as VWO or Adobe Target. Experience working with a customer data platform to build audience segments and target experiences is required by the source role profile.

  

**Knowledge**

Knowledge of A/B testing, holdout groups and statistical significance; customer data platform audience segmentation; web personalisation; analytics and conversion tracking, ideally using GA4 and Google Tag Manager; and quality assurance across browsers and devices.

  

**Skills and Abilities**

Confident HTML, CSS and JavaScript skills to build and adjust page variants without developer support; strong attention to detail; ability to manage several builds and deliver to schedule; clear communication of what was built, how it performed and what should happen next; and ability to collaborate across marketing, analytics, development, design, brand, product marketing and legal teams. Nice-to-have experience includes B2B websites, Contentful, Salesforce, 6sense and AI tools for specifications, QA and documentation.

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.*

At Aptean, our mission is to solve tomorrow’s unique challenges today with unrivaled, purpose-built software and superior customer experiences from people who care. Aptean is a global provider of mission-critical, industry-specific software solutions. Aptean’s purpose-built ERP and supply chain management solutions help address the unique challenges facing process and discrete manufacturers, distributors and other focused organizations. Aptean’s compliance solutions are built for companies serving specific markets such as finance, healthcare, biotech and pharmaceuticals, over 10,000 highly specialized organizations in more than 20 industries and 80 countries rely on Aptean to streamline their everyday operations.

“At Aptean, our global and diverse employee base is our greatest asset. It is through embracing and understanding our differences that we are able to harness our individual power to maximize the success of our customers, our employees and our company.” – TVN Reddy

Aptean pledges to promote a company culture where diversity, equity and inclusion are central. We are committed to applying this principle as we interact with our customers, build our teams, cultivate our leaders and shape a company in which any employee can succeed, regardless of race, color, sex, national origin, sexuality and gender identity, religion, disability or age. Celebrating our diverse experiences, opinions and beliefs allows us to embrace what makes us unique and to use this as an asset in bringing innovative solutions to our customer base.
