title: Data Design and Delivery Specialist
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time Data Solution Lead (Group PMO Hub India) in Bangalore we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your business analysis and data analytics expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and motivated teammates.

You'll play a key role in driving Alstom's digital transformation by enabling data-driven decision-making and delivering impactful analytics solutions. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as the Group PMO, Product Line Offices, Region Project Offices, and Talent/HR Management), lead stakeholder engagements to understand and deliver on business requirements, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of developing and maintaining Business Intelligence (BI) tools, such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Business Objects, and ensuring alignment with business objectives. You’ll also manage user access, specify and test enhancements, and oversee application upgrades.

We’ll look to you for:

* Engaging with stakeholders to collect, document, and prioritize business requirements for analytics and digital solutions.
* Designing and developing dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support fast decision-making by Project and Bid Managers.
* Collaborating with IS/IT partners to define data architecture and ensure accurate and reliable data sources.
* Facilitating requirements and design reviews to secure stakeholder alignment and feedback.
* Driving user-centric design principles to maximize usability and adoption of analytics solutions.
* Coordinating testing, business validation, user acceptance, and deployment readiness.
* Monitoring solution utilization and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Experience in business analysis, requirements management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of Business Intelligence and Data Visualization platforms such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Tableau.
* Familiarity with data mapping, data quality principles, and reporting best practices.
* A certification in Business Analysis, Project Management, Data Analytics, Agile, or Scrum is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational abilities.
  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with diverse, transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards broader leadership or technical roles within Alstom.
* Enjoy a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

**Job Segment:** Database, Business Analyst, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Project Manager, Technology

title: Principal Product Manager- SD-WAN & SASE
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

**About SonicWall**

SonicWall delivers cybersecurity solutions built for the realities of modern distributed networks. Protecting SMBs, mid-market organizations, and enterprises worldwide, SonicWall provides next-generation firewalls, secure connectivity, and cloud-delivered security services that enable organizations to operate securely across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

As networks become increasingly distributed and applications move to the cloud, secure connectivity is no longer optional—it is foundational. SonicWall is investing in a next-generation secure networking platform that integrates advanced **SD-WAN** capabilities with a modern **SASE architecture** to deliver performance, security, and simplified operations for customers and partners.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Principal **Product Manager – SD-WAN & SASE** to drive strategy, roadmap, and execution for SonicWall's secure connectivity platform. This role will lead the evolution of SonicWall's **SD-WAN capabilities and SASE architecture**, delivering integrated networking and security that enables customers to securely connect users, sites, applications, and clouds.

You will work cross-functionally across engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, and partners to define differentiated solutions that address real customer challenges in distributed networking, zero trust access, and cloud security.

This role requires strong expertise in **networking, security architecture, and cloud-delivered services**, along with the ability to translate market opportunities into high-impact products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and execute the **product strategy and roadmap for SonicWall SD-WAN and SASE solutions**.
* Drive the transition from traditional network security architectures to **cloud-delivered secure networking models**.
* Align product direction with emerging industry frameworks such as **Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)** and **Zero Trust Architecture**.
* Identify growth opportunities across SMB, distributed enterprise, and managed service provider segments.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from **concept through launch and ongoing lifecycle management**.
* Translate customer requirements into **detailed product requirements and technical specifications**.
* Work closely with engineering teams to prioritize features, manage tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality releases.
* Ensure tight integration between **SD-WAN, firewall, cloud security, and management platforms**.

**Market & Customer Insights**

* Conduct competitive analysis across the secure networking landscape
* Engage directly with customers, partners, and field teams to understand evolving connectivity and security challenges.
* Define clear product differentiation in performance, ease of deployment, and security integration.

**Go-to-Market Leadership**

* Partner with product marketing to develop **positioning, messaging, and sales enablement**.
* Support field teams with training, customer briefings, and strategic deals.
* Work with channel partners and MSPs to drive adoption of SonicWall's secure networking platform.

  

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 10+ years of product management experience in **networking, cybersecurity, or cloud infrastructure**.
* Strong expertise in **SD-WAN, secure connectivity, or enterprise networking technologies**.
* Experience delivering products aligned with **SASE or cloud-delivered security architectures**.
* Deep understanding of networking concepts including routing, VPNs, WAN optimization, and traffic steering.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex platforms from concept to market.
* Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to influence executive stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* Experience with **firewall platforms, network security appliances, or cloud security services**.
* Familiarity with **Zero Trust networking and secure remote access architectures**.
* Experience working with **managed service providers (MSPs) or channel ecosystems**.
* MBA or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or business.

**Why Join SonicWall**

* Opportunity to shape the future of **secure networking and distributed enterprise connectivity**.
* Work on a platform used by **hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide**.
* Collaborate with industry experts in **cybersecurity, networking, and cloud infrastructure**.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for growth.

**Location:** Jeevan Bima Nagar, Bengaluru (Work from office)  
**Experience:** 1.5 – 3 years in Meta sales campaigns  
**Pay:** ₹35,000 – ₹40,000 per month  
**Working days:** Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM  
**Preferred:** Immediate joiners

**The Role**  
Own the Meta ads for two of our D2C fashion brands, **Varanchi** and **Ila**, which bring handcrafted Indian wear to customers across India. This is an e-commerce role focused on **online sales**: you’ll run campaigns that drive purchases on our website, and handle the full cycle from creative ideas to launching, testing and scaling. You’ll manage a significant monthly ad budget across both brands, which we plan to double within the next year.

**How We Work**  
Our ad accounts are already running, with campaigns, catalogs and tracking in place. You’ll build on what exists and improve it. Creative thinking matters as much as numbers here: the person who runs the ads also helps decide what the ads should say and look like.

You’ll report to our Creative Head, who sets the creative direction, and work closely with our designer and cameraman to get creatives made. Managers will review results with you weekly. You’ll handle day-to-day campaign decisions on your own, within the direction set by the Creative Head.

This is a full-time, in-office role at our Bengaluru office, Monday to Friday, 8 AM – 4 PM. Remote or hybrid work isn’t possible.

**What We Run**

* **Brands:** Varanchi and Ila (D2C fashion, handcrafted Indian wear)
* **Platforms:** Meta – Facebook & Instagram
* **Campaign objective:** Sales/purchases on our online store
* **Ad formats:** Catalog/Advantage+, video (Reels, Stories, feed), static and partnership ads
* **Creative production:** In-house designer and cameraman, plus our own studio and store for shoots

**What You’ll Do**

* Plan budget allocation across the funnel (prospecting, retargeting, retention) and between both brands, and scale spend profitably
* Launch and manage sales campaigns across all our ad formats
* Monitor delivery, pacing and spend daily, and optimise for ROAS, purchases and cost per purchase, pausing what’s not working and scaling what is
* Find scaling opportunities through audience expansion, retargeting and lookalikes
* QA every launch: creatives, tracking links, audiences and conversion events
* Come up with a steady stream of ad ideas, drawing on regular competitor monitoring through Meta Ad Library and Instagram. We’re building toward testing around 10 unique creatives per ad set
* Write ad copies, hooks and video scripts, and brief our designer and cameraman to get creatives made on time
* Plan festive and seasonal campaigns (Diwali, weddings, Onam, Pongal and more), including ad shoots in our studio and store
* Work with our purchase and production teams so the products performing well in ads stay in stock and get restocked on time
* Run a creative testing calendar and share a weekly report on results, learnings and next steps

**Must-Have**

* **1.5+ years of hands-on experience running Meta sales/purchase campaigns for an online store (e-commerce or D2C).** Experience only in lead generation, app installs, traffic or engagement campaigns will not be considered
* Experience managing monthly Meta budgets of ₹4 lakh or more, with a track record of scaling campaigns profitably
* Strong knowledge of campaign structures, audiences (custom and lookalike), bidding strategies, Meta Pixel and Events Manager
* A good eye for scroll-stopping creatives and strong writing skills for ad copy and scripts
* Experience briefing designers or video teams to get ad creatives made
* Clear communication and reporting: you can explain what happened, why, and what you’ll do next
* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail

* Experience with catalog, partnership and video ads

* Knowledge of WhatsApp marketing (broadcasts, remarketing, click-to-WhatsApp ads)

As you settle in, you’ll also get the chance to help shape our upcoming creator program.

description:

**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

**About the role:** This role defines product strategy and drives business growth by translating market and stakeholder needs into actionable priorities. The Product Manager identifies growth opportunities through adoption analysis, assesses product potential, and develops commercial strategies, including pricing and offering tiers. The role oversees the product lifecycle—from roadmap prioritization and development tracking to launch and post-launch feedback—while connecting stakeholders, engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success. It also monitors competitors and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Product Strategy & Business Case**

* Define the product vision, strategy, and value proposition aligned to business objectives.
* Build business cases covering market opportunity, customer need, competitive positioning, revenue potential, investment, and ROI.
* Develop financial models, pricing scenarios, and commercialization strategies.
* Present investment recommendations to leadership; track market trends and emerging technology to drive innovation.

**2. Pricing & Commercial Strategy**

* Define pricing, packaging, and monetization models; benchmark against competitive pricing.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and business leaders to optimize commercial models.
* Monitor profitability, ARR, margin, adoption, and customer lifetime value, and recommend pricing adjustments.

**3. Roadmap & Prioritization**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap; translate opportunities into initiatives, epics, and releases.
* Facilitate prioritization workshops balancing customer need, business value, technical feasibility, and strategy.
* Apply prioritization frameworks based on ROI, customer impact, and market demand.
* Drive alignment across engineering, UX, customer success, sales, and executive stakeholders.

**4. Requirements Management**

* Gather, analyze, and document business and customer requirements.
* Author PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional/non-functional specifications.
* Work with UX and Engineering to refine solutions and validate technical feasibility.
* Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and product reviews.

**5. Launch & Adoption**

* Define launch, enablement, and adoption strategies; execute go-to-market plans with Marketing and Sales.
* Drive onboarding, customer training, and customer success initiatives.
* Track adoption, usage, engagement, retention, and revenue performance.
* Identify adoption barriers, act on post-release feedback, and improve value realization.

**6. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership**

* Act as the primary point of contact for product decisions across internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate consensus and decision-making across diverse groups.
* Report roadmap progress, product performance, risks, and opportunities; influence strategy with data-driven recommendations.

**7. Performance & Analytics**

* Define and track product KPIs and success metrics.
* Measure adoption, retention, revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and ROI.
* Maintain executive dashboards and lead periodic product performance reviews.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, or Computer Science; or an MBA with specialization in Product Management.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or Product Strategy roles.
* Demonstrated experience across business case development, pricing and commercialization, roadmap management, requirements documentation, and go-to-market execution.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum product development methodologies.
* Strong analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving capability.
* Experience with SaaS, digital, or platform products and subscription-based business models.
* Exposure to product analytics tooling and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience managing products across multiple markets, segments, or channel partners.

title: Media Intern (Influencer & Showbiz)
description:
**Three months to learn how brands get into films, feeds and headlines.**

Excellent Publicity is a media and advertising company. Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000+ brands, including the likes of Google, RBI, IIM-A, Amazon, Uber and Apple, across 3,00,000+ campaigns spanning hoardings, airports, metro and transit, newspapers, radio, cinema, television, digital, performance, influencer and sports.

We are an energetic young team of almost 100 people across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru and Dubai, with a strong in-house tech team building AI-powered products, including Epifluent, our influencer discovery and intelligence platform, and EPitch, which builds detailed media plans and strategies in hours.

**About the internship**

This is the entertainment side of media. Over three months you will work on live influencer campaigns, brand associations with celebrities, product placements inside films and shows, and the PR and co-branding tie-ups that get a brand talked about rather than simply seen.

You will not be making tea or sitting through presentations. You will work alongside the team on real client mandates, deal with influencers, talent managers, agencies and production houses, and see campaigns through from the first shortlist to the final report.

**This internship is built to convert.** Interns who do the work well receive a Pre-Placement Offer as an Associate Media Manager at the end of the three months.

**What you will do**

* **Find the right faces.** Research and shortlist influencers and celebrities against the client brief, the audience and the campaign objective, and build a case for why each one fits.
* **Build the network.** Coordinate day to day with influencers, talent managers, agencies, production houses and media vendors.
* **Support celebrity associations.** Assist on brand endorsements, celebrity collaborations and promotional partnerships from first conversation to signed deliverable.
* **See brands placed inside entertainment.** Work on in-film branding, movie integrations, promotional tie-ups, PR opportunities and co-branding associations.
* **Help plan and negotiate.** Assist in preparing campaign plans, budgets and timelines, and sit in on rate and deliverable negotiations with influencers, agencies and partners.
* **Keep campaigns on track.** Follow up on committed deliverables, coordinate between internal teams and external partners, and make sure nothing slips.
* **Close the loop.** Maintain clean trackers and documentation, and help prepare the performance reports that go to clients.

**Your three months:**

**Month 1 -** Learn how influencer, celebrity, in-film and PR deals are priced and structured. Shadow live campaigns, build research and shortlists, and start your own contact list of talent managers and agencies.

**Month 2** - Take ownership of your own research, shortlists and coordination on live campaigns. Handle deliverable tracking and vendor follow-ups directly.

**Month 3** - Support a campaign end to end, from shortlist through execution to the final report, and present your work to the team. This month is also your PPO assessment.

**Who we are looking for:**

* **Clear communication, written and spoken.** A large part of this job is putting an idea across clearly and following it up in writing.
* **Confident on a call.** You can speak to an influencer, a talent manager or an agency without losing your nerve, or you are willing to learn fast.
* **Organised, with real attention to detail.** You can keep several campaigns and deadlines tracked at once. Campaigns fail on missed dates, not on bad ideas.
* **Genuinely interested in entertainment, influencer marketing, PR and digital.** You follow what is happening in films, creators and brand campaigns because you want to, not because the job asks you to.
* **Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.** You will build trackers and help with client presentations.
* **Available full-time for three months,** on-site in Ahmedabad, and serious about converting this into a full-time role.

*Final-year students and recent graduates from any stream. Prior internship or college project experience in influencer marketing, PR, talent management or entertainment is a plus, not a requirement.*

**What you will get:**

* **Stipend** - ₹15,000 - ₹18,000 per month
* **Pre-Placement Offer** - A full-time offer as Associate Media Manager (Influencer & Showbiz) for interns who perform through the three months
* **Also**, Travel reimbursed at actuals, a completion certificate, and real exposure to influencer, celebrity, in-film and PR mandates for national brands

**Where this goes:**  
Intern, then Associate Media Manager on conversion, then Media Manager at 18 to 24 months, then Senior Media Manager or Vertical Lead. Influencer and entertainment is one of the fastest growing parts of Indian advertising, and the people who know how these deals are actually built are scarce. We would like you to build that here.

**How to apply:**

**Email chahal@excellentpublicity.com or WhatsApp +917486031011. Subject line: Influencer & Showbiz Internship - Ahmedabad**

Attach your CV, and in the body name one influencer campaign, celebrity endorsement or in-film placement you have noticed recently, and tell us in three or four lines why you think it worked or did not work.

That answer is what we will read first. Shortlisted candidates hear from us within 4 working days.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Growth Lead
description:
**About Us**
  

  

Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life\-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru\-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.
  

  

Today, 20 million\+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.
  

  

We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way.
  

  

Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million\+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
  

  

And this is just the beginning!
  

  

**What’s the role?**
  

  

Jar's gold savings business is the core of the company. It serves first\-time digital savers, largely outside the metros, and it moves real money every day. We are looking for a Growth Lead to own it end to end.
  

  

This is a P\&L\-shaped role rather than a channel\-shaped one. You will own gold GMV and every input that produces it: activating new savers, increasing the frequency and ticket size of existing ones, retaining them, winning back the ones who have gone quiet, and expanding them into adjacent products. The measure of success is a durable change in the slope of the business, not a good quarter.
  

  

The distinction that matters most to us is how you get there. We are looking for someone who drives growth primarily through product, and uses campaigns, lifecycle and comms to amplify what the product has already earned. Teams that lean on discounting and notification volume can hold a number for a quarter. They cannot compound. You will have a cross\-functional pod of product managers, growth managers, analysts and lifecycle owners to do this properly, and you will own the roadmap that directs them.
  

  

You will report to the VP of Growth who currently holds this scope alongside Jar's jewellery vertical and new business lines. You will be reviewed on the business and its narrative, not on individual projects.

  

  

**What will be your responsibilities?**  

  



*Own the GMV equation*


* Decompose gold GMV into its constituent inputs and maintain a clear point of view on which input is binding in any given quarter.
* Set the roadmap and sequencing across activation, frequency, retention, win\-back and cross\-sell, and defend the trade\-offs between them.
* Carry the number. Report performance and the reasoning behind it directly to leadership.
  


  

*Grow revenue per user*


* Increase transaction frequency and ticket size through changes to the saving experience: habit loops, goals, streaks, visible progress, and the moments that bring a user back unprompted.
* Identify and close leakage across the transactional spine \- accumulation flows, autopay, withdrawals and liquidation, pricing, rewards and refunds.
* Build the cross\-sell and upsell path into Jar's wider surface without cannibalising core saving behaviour.
  


  

*Retain and win back*


* Own retention as a product problem. Diagnose why cohorts decay and fix the reasons, rather than managing the symptom through lifecycle messaging.
* Segment dormant and churned users by cause of departure and build differentiated win\-back paths for each.
  


  

*Drive experimentation*


* Design and run a high\-throughput experiment programme with clear hypotheses, adequate power, and honest read\-outs.
* Make kill decisions quickly and document what was learned. Protect the team from shipping things that tested flat.
  


  

*Lead the pod*


* Manage and grow a cross\-functional team of product managers, growth managers, analysts and lifecycle owners.
* Set the hiring bar for your team and make the selection calls.
* Work closely with engineering, design, data and marketing to get work shipped on pace.
  


  

*Operate the business*


* Maintain the instrumentation and dashboards needed to know the state of the business without being told.
* Respond to breakages in a live money product with appropriate urgency, and close the detection gaps that allowed them to go unnoticed.
  

  

**What’s required from you?**  

  



* 7\+ years in consumer growth, product or monetisation roles, including at least 2 years managing a team or a pod.
* Demonstrable ownership of a revenue or GMV number, with the ability to speak precisely about what you moved and how.
* A track record of product\-led growth. You should be able to walk through a product change you shipped that durably moved a retention or frequency metric, and explain why it worked.
* Strong quantitative foundation. SQL fluency is expected and not delegated. Comfort with cohort analysis, funnel instrumentation and experiment design.
* Experience in consumer fintech, commerce, mobility, or on\-demand at scale in India. Exposure to Tier 2 and Tier 3 users is a significant advantage; instincts built on metro\-affluent products do not transfer cleanly.
* Bachelor's in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline from a reputed institute, or an MBA from a reputed institute.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and limited supervision. This role assumes you will find your own problems.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You will be explaining the business to leadership and to your team on a weekly cadence.
* Working knowledge of analytics and lifecycle tooling (Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, Data Studio or equivalent).
  

  

**What makes us different?**
  

  

We’re not just building a product—we’re shaping the future of savings in India. We seek people who bring passion, energy, and fresh ideas to help us make that happen. Experience matters, but we are a potential first organisation. We move fast, learn from our mistakes, and take bold risks to solve problems that haven’t been attempted before. If you’re excited about working in an environment where people inspire and truly support each other, you’ve found the right fit.
  

  

**What do we stand for?**
  

  

The five values that we live by :
  

  

**Passion:** At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work.
  

**Equality:** We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves.
  

**Growth:** When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact.
  

**Accountability:** The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions.
  

**Consistency:** We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time.
  

  

Join us and let’s build something amazing together!
  

  

**What employee benefits do we have?**

### **Job Type:**

#### **Life at EvoluteIQ:**


We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry\-leading technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.


To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self\-driven and collaborative. People who not only want to be a part of a fast\-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and care—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.


**Could that be you?**


#### **The EIQ Mission:**


Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a **“dent in the universe”.** Our core fabric is Innovation! And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.


Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive every day at EvoluteIQ. To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge.


We make building of automation simple for everyone, so that it is not mystery for a few.


**Would you like to be part of this journey?**


We are looking for an **Associate Product Manager** to partner closely with one of our Product Managers – covering AI/ML, Data Platform, Low\-Code/No\-Code functionalities – bringing structure and rigor to how we capture, document and track product requirements. This role blends classic associate product management with a strong business analysis orientation: you will turn conversations, roadmap decisions and technical discussions into clear, reliable documentation the wider team can build against. It is a foundational role for someone who wants to build deep product craft inside a fast\-moving deep\-tech company. This role calls for 2\-5 years of overall experience, including some hands\-on exposure to product management, business analysis or a related function in enterprise software or B2B SaaS.


#### **What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:**


##### **Partner with Your Product Manager**


* Work day\-to\-day alongside your assigned Product Manager, supporting roadmap planning, prioritization and stakeholder communication.
* Prepare briefing materials, roadmap updates and status reports for leadership and cross\-functional reviews.
* Track decisions, action items and open questions across product discussions, and follow up until closed.
* Flag gaps, risks and dependencies early so your Product Manager can act on them.
##### **Understand Users and the Market**


* Support research into customer needs, competitor capabilities and industry trends for your product area.
* Join customer and partner conversations to capture requirements and pain points first\-hand.
* Help evaluate and validate use cases, prioritising for business value under your Product Manager’s guidance.
##### **Own Requirements and Documentation**


* Write clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.
* Maintain accurate, current documentation on feature scope, workflows, design decisions and known limitations.
* Translate business and technical discussions into structured requirements that engineering can build against without ambiguity.
* Create and maintain process maps, workflow diagrams and other artefacts that make the product easy to understand for the wider team.
##### **Support Delivery**


* Work with engineering, QA and design to keep backlogs groomed and sprint planning organized.
* Track delivery progress against the roadmap, and surface slippage or blockers promptly.
* Support release readiness: test scenarios, release notes, and coordination with go\-to\-market teams.
##### **Build Product and Technical Fluency**


* Develop a working understanding of agentic AI and LLM\-based systems relevant to your product area.
* Build familiarity with data platforms, pipelines and how data quality shapes AI product outcomes.
* Use AI tooling in your own research, documentation and analysis, and look for ways to raise the team’s documentation standard.
#### **What will you bring to the team?**


* 2\-5 years of overall experience, including some hands\-on exposure to product management, business analysis or a related function in enterprise software or B2B SaaS.
* Strong written documentation skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous discussions into clear specifications.
* Comfort working directly with engineering, design and business stakeholders.
* A structured, detail\-oriented approach to tracking requirements, decisions and action items.
* Curiosity about AI/ML, agentic AI and low\-code/no\-code technologies.
* Clear verbal and written communication.
* Exposure to agile ceremonies such as backlog grooming and sprint planning.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent for documentation and tracking.
#### **How Success Will Be Measured:**


* Documentation (PRDs, specs, user stories) is clear enough that engineering rarely needs clarification.
* Requirements captured from stakeholders are accurate and complete, reducing rework mid\-sprint.
* Your Product Manager can delegate research, documentation and coordination with confidence.
* You show growing independence in discovery support and requirement\-writing.
* Meeting notes and action tracking are reliable enough to serve as the team’s system of record.
#### **What We Offer:**


* Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next\-gen hyper\-automation platform.
* Work with a cross\-disciplinary team in a fast\-growing, innovation\-driven environment.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.
* A culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
Ready to take the next step in your career journey with us? Apply now and become part of a dynamic team that values expertise, collaboration, and a positive work culture!


Don’t Meet Every Requirement? We Still Want to Hear From You!


Please go ahead and apply anyway.


We know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes and passion can’t be learned. If you believe, then we would like to meet you and explore that belief!


We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes.

description:
* **️ About Merkle Science**


Merkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate, and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies. Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies.  

Merkle Science is headquartered in New York with offices in Singapore, Bangalore and London. The team has combined experience across Bank of America, Paypal, Luno, Thomson Reuters and Amazon. The company has raised over $27M from SIG, Beco, Republic, DCG, Kenetic, GGV and several others.  

What will you do?
* Own one of our core products (crypto\-forensics or crypto transaction monitoring), its roadmap and vision


* Collaborate closely with product designers and engineers to launch easy to use solutions to solve complex problems


* Coordinate with customers to understand their requirements, and help evolve our existing products based on customer feedback


* Serve as the central point of contact that connects sales, marketing and engineering teams and helps in cross\-collaboration



 What are we looking for?
* You have some experience with fast\-paced product tracks and have been in product development roles, preferably Enterprise SaaS offerings in the past.


* You enjoy working on cutting\-edge projects in the cryptocurrency space


* You have user empathy and can prioritise effectively


* You understand the importance of concrete business metrics, product\-driven acquisition, customer engagement and retention, onboarding driven activation and naturally think along these lines.


* You enjoy the process of discovery with customers and bring a strong sense of empathy and a user\-centric approach to product management.


* You treat customer NPS as your holy grail but can weed out subjectivity from the customer inputs to keep items actionable



 **What process do we follow? (\<2 weeks)**
1\. Application: We will keep it simple. You can apply directly through our job portal. All we ask for is a Resume. Additional Portfolio links such as Github, Medium or a Personal website are welcome
2\. Screening: We will screen your profile and get back with a decision asap
3\. Interviews: We will have two rounds of interviews. Round one (30mins) Intro call that will focus on getting to know each other better and identifying if this could work for both of us. Round two (60mins) is a technical round where we will review your prior experience and discuss how you would build systems to solve a problem we will introduce on call. An additional third round\-technical may be decided based on the previous rounds
4\. Meet the Team: Culture\-Fit is essential for both you and us. So we always go the extra mile, and you will meet two other colleagues on the team who you would be working with. Here, you could discuss questions on stack, culture and some other things you might be interested in if you had a consideration for a new role.
5\. Offer Rollout: If all looks well, we will open a bottle of champagne.

 Other information you may want to consider
* We will be flexible for the rest of the pandemic and work remotely; however, we are not a remote\-first company, and the work location would be Bangalore when things settle.

We care about your well\-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning \& development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance. We regularly host team\-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health.  

  

We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions. We offer industry\-leading compensation, along with generous equity. As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Loyalytics**
Loyalytics is a fast\-growing Analytics consulting and product organization based out of Bangalore. We work with large retail clients across the globe helping them monetize their data assets through our consulting assignments and product accelerators. We are a young dynamic team of analytics practitioners working on some of the most cutting\-edge tools and technologies.
We has spent over a decade building retail intelligence for the GCC’s largest retailers. Swan, our platform, powers customer data, loyalty, segmentation, and campaigns for brands/ Clients. We are bootstrapped. That means we grew by solving real problems for paying customers, not by spending investor money, and it means every feature we build has a real retailer waiting for it. We run a deliberately lean team across Dubai, India, and Indonesia. **Who we are:*** Technical team: A team full of data scientists, data engineers and business analysts who work with 1M\+ data points every day.
* Market Size: Massive multi\-billion $ global market opportunity.
* Leadership: Combined experience of 40\+ years of experience in the industry.
* Customers: Word\-of\-mouth and referral driven marketing to acquire customers like big retail brands in GCC regions like Lulu, GMG, among others (Strong product\-market fit).
* What makes us stand apart: 10 years old bootstrapped and 100\+ people company that is still hiring.

 **Our Product**Swan is a customer engagement platform helping enterprises drive personalized, data\-driven engagement at scale. We work with customers across the Middle East (GCC) and are expanding into new geographies. Our platform is multi\-tenant, cloud\-native, and heavily data\-driven, handling sensitive customer engagement and demographic data. We are fully deployed on Microsoft Azure and are ISO 27001 certified. **Role Overview**
We’ve just launched Swan 2\.0, our new platform, and we are rebuilding the product around AI from the ground up. This is not a chatbot bolted onto an old CRM. Some of what’s already in motion:* Real\-time product recommendations generated on demand for email and WhatsApp campaigns, at tens of thousands of recommendations per second, straight from live retail data.
* An internal fleet of autonomous AI agents that detect signals in customer data, generate hypotheses, write code, and help resolve customer issues.
* An AI\-native way of working across the company, where the first question on any problem is “how would AI help here?”


We are hiring a product manager to build our product management function and to reimagine what a retail marketer’s day looks like when the software can think alongside them. **Key Responsibilities*** **Build the product function.** Set up how product works here: how problems are discovered, written up, prioritised, tracked in Linear, shipped, and measured. You’ll define the operating rhythm the rest of the team follows.
* **Live close to customers.** Spend real time with CRM heads, marketing teams, and store operations at some of the region’s biggest retailers. Understand their business pressures, not just their feature requests.
* **Solve problems from first principles.** Take messy, ambiguous problems (a campaign that underperformed, a flow that confuses users, a gap blocking a customer’s migration) and break them down logically before reaching for a solution.
* **Reimagine the flows.** Question every inherited workflow. Design AI\-native experiences where the product proposes and the marketer decides, rather than copying how CRMs have always worked.
* **Work as an engineering peer.** Partner with engineers on data models, APIs, scope, and trade\-offs. Understand the system well enough to make sound calls and to catch weak ones.
* **Use AI as your default tool.** Prototype, analyse data, synthesise research, and draft specs with AI, and help the team work the same way.
* **Let data decide.** Define success metrics before building. Use product analytics and SQL to measure adoption and impact. Retire what doesn’t work.
* **Own launches end to end.** From spec to rollout to customer adoption, including features that customers need as they move onto Swan 2\.0\.

 **Must\-Have Skills \& Experience*** **4–8 years in product management**, with meaningful time on **CRM, loyalty, marketing technology, or retail / e\-commerce products.**
* **B2B SaaS experience working directly with enterprise customers.**
* Technical fluency: comfortable with **APIs, data models, and event data; able to write SQL**. An engineering background, or years of shipping closely alongside engineers, is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on **AI usage: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or Lovable** every day, and can show us something you’ve built, automated, or figured out with them.
* Evidence of process discipline: you’ve run a clean backlog, written specs people actually used, and set up team rituals that stuck.

 **Good\-to\-Have*** Experience with **GCC or Middle East retail.**
* **Loyalty programmes, customer data platforms, or WhatsApp / email / SMS campaign orchestration.**
* **Built a product function** or first product team from scratch.
* Designed **LLM features or worked with AI agents** in production.

 **What Success Looks Like*** The chance to build the product function at a company with real customers and real revenue.
* Direct, day\-to\-day work with the founders.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Everyday Essentials Experience Org delivers a world\-class shopping experience for everyday essentials that is efficient, habitual, and economical for customers and selling partners. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with strong ownership and a drive to solve complex, large\-scale problems through creative solutions.  

  

The Everyday Essential Cost to Serve team drives multi\-million dollar cost savings for Amazon through its multipack programs. The team owns how Amazon represents, prices, and fulfills multipack products worldwide, and is currently executing a ground\-up re\-architecture of the multipack platform as a leadership\-priority initiative, promoting multipacks to first\-class purchasable products. This work changes how millions of customers discover, purchase, and receive multipacks, and how selling partners manage their multipack catalog.  

  

What makes this role unique is the breadth. Your work will span the entire retail funnel: ASIN creation, catalog ingestion, pricing determination, selection and ranking, and customer\-facing experiences on Search, Detail Page, Cart, Checkout,  

and the multipacks storefront. You will work closely with the science team and have the opportunity to develop and influence the models that drive multipack selection and personalization. Few teams at Amazon offer this combination of  

end\-to\-end systems exposure.  

  

You will build systems that separate what a customer buys from how it is fulfilled, enabling seamless multipack experiences from online multipacks fulfilled with individual units to physical products shipped as a single item. You will have the freedom to experiment, propose new multipack experiences, and ship them worldwide. Your ideas move from whiteboard to production, visible to hundreds of millions of customers. You will shape foundational decisions in an active re\-architecture program with high visibility to senior leadership  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Design, build, and own end\-to\-end software solutions that are scalable, reliable, and maintainable across the full software development lifecycle.
  

Collaborate with product managers, principal engineers, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical designs and working software.
  

Drive continuous improvement by identifying gaps in existing systems, proposing solutions, and delivering results with a high bar for quality and operational excellence.
  

Participate actively in code reviews, contribute to team best practices, and mentor junior engineers to raise the technical bar across the team.  

Operate with a good sense of ownership — monitoring systems you build, responding to operational issues, and iterating quickly to improve customer and partner experience.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole’s 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.
 



**Our Values** 




 Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
 


* **We Do What We Say:** 
 We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** 
 We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** 
 We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** 
 We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.



 If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to work with the Director of Product and help set the strategic direction for our Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) product line. This is a senior, high\-impact individual contributor role: you will own the planning and execution for CLM, help shape company\-level bets on where crypto\-agility and CLM automation are headed, and act as the most senior product voice across a portfolio of related modules and initiatives.
 



 You will operate with significant autonomy, partnering directly with engineering leadership, design, sales, and executive stakeholders to translate market and regulatory shifts into a coherent, differentiated roadmap. You will also raise the bar for the broader product organization, mentoring senior and mid\-level PMs, setting standards for discovery and requirements gathering, and representing AppViewX’s CLM strategy with customers, and industry forums.
 



 You bring deep product instincts, sharp executive and customer communication, and strong technical fluency in PKI and certificate management. You are comfortable operating ambiguously at the strategy layer while still being able to go deep into requirements, architecture trade\-offs, and cross\-functional execution when it matters most.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own the roadmap for Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), aligning it with company strategy, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and enterprise customer needs.
* Act as the senior product strategist for CLM, setting priorities across multiple modules and workstreams and ensuring coherence across the broader product portfolio.
* Lead deep discovery engagements with enterprise customers, PKI architects, and customer stakeholders to surface strategic pain points around certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and visibility.
* Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, eIDAS, FIPS 140\-2\) into a coherent, forward\-looking set of product capabilities and standards.
* Define AppViewX’s point of view and product response to major industry shifts, including post\-quantum cryptography (PQC), short\-lived certificates (47\-day validity), and Zero Trust models, working closely with engineering and architecture teams.
* Set the bar for product requirements quality across the team, writing and reviewing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the most complex, ambiguous, or cross\-cutting initiatives.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid\-level PMs, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the overall maturity of product practices, documentation, and process across the organization.
* Collaborate closely with Design on the end\-to\-end experience for certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal automation, and policy enforcement, ensuring consistency across a growing product portfolio.
* Represent AppViewX’s CLM product strategy and roadmap externally with key customers, prospects, and at conferences or forums as needed.
* Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and technical field teams aligning diverse stakeholders from individual contributors to the C\-suite around a shared strategic direction.



 Required Qualifications:
 


* 10\+ years of product management experience, including at least 4\+ years operating at a senior/lead or principal level owning strategy for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product.
* Demonstrated track record of owning product strategy end\-to\-end, from market analysis and vision\-setting through execution, launch, and iteration at scale.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills; experienced with product analytics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and using data to inform multi\-quarter strategic bets.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence senior executives and align cross\-functional stakeholders spanning engineering, design, technical sales, and leadership.
* Significant experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government, telecoms), including direct engagement with security and compliance stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing complex, API\-first products and platform\-level integrations.
* Experience mentoring or leading other product managers, or otherwise operating as a force multiplier for a product organization.



 Domain Expertise (Preferred):
 



 Direct CLM or PKI leadership experience is strongly preferred. Candidates who can demonstrate the following will have a significant advantage:
 


* Deep, strategic understanding of a CLM or PKI management platform, including X.509 certificate standards, certificate authorities (public and private), trust chains, and revocation mechanisms (CRL, OCSP).
* Familiarity with certificate enrollment protocols: ACME, SCEP, EST, and REST\-based CA APIs, and how they shape automation and integration strategy.
* Experience setting strategy for automation workflows, and working knowledge of HSM (Hardware Security Module), key management, and cryptographic policy enforcement at an enterprise scale.



**What’s more in store?** 





 AppViewX is on par with leading global companies when it comes to the benefits it offers its employees, ranging from competitive incentives, health \& wellness policies, saving \& investment schemes, time off/sabbatical eligibility and dedicated L\&D.
 



 What we consider equally important is the flexibility we offer our employees to – work remotely, define their own hours, and more importantly harmonize both work and life. The more trust and accountability we place on our employees, the more they surpass our goals and expectations.
 



**Why AppViewX?** 




 AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.

In this role, you will own a defined product area within Patient Messaging, driving the roadmap for AI\-enabled communication capabilities that help patients and care teams connect efficiently and safely. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Every year, employers and employees spend more than $5 trillion on benefits globally. These products—from health insurance and retirement to fertility, mental health, telemedicine, and financial wellness—shape some of the most important decisions families make. Yet discovering, purchasing, and managing them remains fragmented, expensive, and confusing.
   

  

 Rippling is building the first modern benefits marketplace that connects brokers, employers, employees, and benefit providers in one platform. Our benefits vertical includes the Rippling Benefits Platform, a rapidly growing marketplace of more than 100 partners, Rippling\-native benefits products, and Rippling PEO.
   

  

 We are looking for a Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace \& PEO to turn these product assets into a scaled growth engine. You will own the strategy and product roadmap to unlock growth by expanding the customers and benefit categories Rippling can serve. This role will play a central role increasing marketplace adoption and revenue.
   

  

 This is a highly cross\-functional, zero\-to\-one role at the intersection of product, growth and go\-to\-market. You will work with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Benefits Advisors, Business Development and Operations,. Success will be measured in business outcomes—including qualified demand, funnel conversion and revenue and not only in features shipped.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the growth strategy and corresponding product roadmap for the Benefits Marketplace and PEO, with a clear mandate to expand the addressable market.
* Execute product led growth plan across benefit categories, geographies, employer profiles, and distribution channels.
* Expand the marketplace's addressable market by identifying and prioritizing new customer segments based on unmet demand, revenue potential, strategic deal unlocks, and Rippling's right to win.

 What you will need
   

  

* 8\+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of growth in B2B products.
* A track record of delivering measurable business outcomes—such as revenue, conversion, retention, attach, adoption, supply growth — through a combination of product and go\-to\-market levers.
* Strong product judgment and commercial instincts: You can connect customer problems, market dynamics and growth strategy into coherent product capabilities.
* Excellent analytical skills: You can define a funnel, build a business case, segment customers and partners, evaluate experiments, and turn ambiguous data into clear decisions.
* Customer obsession: You are equally comfortable speaking with employers, employees, brokers, partners, sales teams, and operations —and translating their needs into scalable products.
* Strong technical fluency and systems thinking. You can work effectively with engineers on data models, integrations, AI\-powered workflows, operational tooling, and platform capabilities without losing sight of the customer or business outcome.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to align executives and cross\-functional teams around a strategy, metrics, priorities, and tradeoffs.

* Experience in benefits, insurance, PEO, payroll, marketplaces, partner ecosystems, or B2B2C products is a strong plus.
* Founder or hypergrowth startup experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with Rippling's leadership principles, especially Go and See and Are Right, a Lot.

Experience: 6 \+ Years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering  

Shift: Timing/rotation etc. details  

Main location: India, Karnataka, Bangalore and Hyderabad.  

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.  

  

Position Summary  

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner with 6\+ years of overall experience, including strong exposure to the insurance domain and Agile product delivery. The Product Owner will be responsible for translating business needs into clear product requirements, managing and prioritizing the product backlog, and working closely with business stakeholders, architects, engineering, quality assurance, and implementation teams to deliver high quality insurance solutions.  

The ideal candidate should have a sound understanding of insurance products, rating processes, policy administration, underwriting, and product configuration. Experience with Ratabase will be an added advantage.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

. Own and manage the product backlog in alignment with the product vision, roadmap, client priorities, and business objectives.  

. Work with insurance business stakeholders, subject matter experts, clients, and internal teams to gather, analyze, and document requirements.  

. Convert business requirements into clear and actionable: Epics Features User stories Acceptance criteria Business rules Process flows  

. Prioritize backlog items based on business value, client impact, risk, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and delivery capacity.  

. Ensure user stories are sufficiently refined and ready for sprint planning and development.  

. Collaborate with engineering, architecture, UX, quality assurance, infrastructure, and implementation teams throughout the product development lifecycle.  

. Participate in Agile ceremonies, including: Backlog refinement Sprint planning Daily stand ups Sprint reviews and demonstrations Retrospectives Program Increment planning, where applicable  

. Clarify functional requirements and provide timely decisions to development and testing teams.  

. Define acceptance criteria and review completed features to ensure they meet business and functional expectations.  

. Support functional testing, defect triage, user acceptance testing, release readiness, and production implementation activities.  

. Evaluate defects and enhancement requests based on severity, business impact, and product strategy.  

. Maintain product documentation, requirement traceability, release scope, and stakeholder communication.  

. Identify dependencies, risks, assumptions, and gaps early in the delivery lifecycle and drive them to resolution.  

. Monitor product adoption, quality, client feedback, and delivery outcomes to support continuous improvement.  

. Contribute to product roadmap planning and provide inputs for effort estimation, release planning, and prioritization.  

. Ensure delivered functionality complies with insurance business rules, audit requirements, security standards, and applicable regulations.  

. Stay informed about insurance industry trends, digital transformation, automation, and emerging technologies.  

  



**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Required Qualifications and Experience  

  

. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Insurance, or a related field.  

. 6\+ years of overall experience in business analysis, product ownership, product management, or software delivery.  

. At least 3 years of experience working as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in an Agile software development environment.  

. Strong experience in the insurance domain, preferably Property and Casualty insurance.  

. Good understanding of one or more of the following: Insurance product configuration Rating and premium calculation Underwriting rules Policy lifecycle Quotes, endorsements, renewals, cancellations, and reinstatements Forms and filings Rules, rates, factors, tables, and formulas Policy administration systems  

. Experience creating and managing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product backlogs.  

. Strong knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.  

. Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent product management platforms.  

. Ability to understand technical concepts, APIs, databases, integrations, application workflows, and non functional requirements.  

. Strong analytical, problem solving, decision making, and prioritization skills.  

. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  

. Ability to work effectively with distributed and cross functional teams.  

. Strong stakeholder management and client facing capabilities.  

  

  

Preferred Qualifications  

  

. Experience with commercial insurance or personal lines products such as: Personal Auto Commercial Auto General Liability Workers' Compensation Businessowners Policy Property Inland Marine Umbrella or Excess Liability  

. Experience working with insurance policy administration or rating platforms.  

. Exposure to Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or similar insurance technology platforms.  

. Experience supporting client implementations, migrations, upgrades, or production releases.  

. Knowledge of insurance regulatory and bureau filings, including ISO, NCCI, or state specific requirements.  

. Product Owner or Agile certifications such as: Certified Scrum Product Owner SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager PMI Agile Certified Practitioner  

. Exposure to AI assisted product delivery, requirements analysis, automation, or software development tools.  

  

  

Key Competencies  

  

. Product vision and ownership  

. Insurance domain expertise  

. Business and systems analysis  

. Backlog management and prioritization  

. Requirements elicitation and documentation  

. Stakeholder and client management  

. Agile product delivery  

. Decision making and problem solving  

. Cross functional collaboration  

. Release and dependency management  

. Quality and client outcome focus

Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

title: Digital Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

As a Digital Product Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the processes related to the definition and delivery of digital products. You will develop functional specifications, including capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, based on feedback from internal and external stakeholders. You will collaborate with business and technology teams to define product strategy, prioritize features, and drive successful product delivery.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Define and lead product strategy and roadmap for digital healthcare and pharmacy solutions
* Elicit, analyze, and translate business requirements into capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Partner with stakeholders to define product vision, roadmap, and release priorities
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog and ensure alignment with business objectives
* Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate capabilities, define solution alternatives, and prioritize product releases
* Effectively communicate product vision, roadmap, and feature requirements to development teams
* Work closely with UX and engineering teams to shape product design and user experience
* Generate release notes, demo scripts, and conduct product demonstrations for stakeholders and clients
* Independently identify and analyze relevant data to support product decisions and business cases
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of product capabilities and feature requirements
* Drive continuous improvement by acting on feedback received during retrospectives and product reviews
* Identify potential risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies
* Foster a culture of innovation across the product portfolio
* Collaborate effectively with onsite and offshore teams to assess requirements and deliver solutions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Allied Health Sciences, MCA, or a related field
* 5\+ years of IT industry experience, including at least 3 years in Healthcare Informatics, Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analysis roles
* Experience in Healthcare, Pharmacy, PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Management), or related healthcare technology domains
* Experience defining capabilities, features, user stories, wireframes, and acceptance criteria
* Proven experience managing product backlogs and working within Agile product development frameworks
* Experience collaborating with development teams throughout feature implementation and delivery
* Solid understanding of healthcare workflows, pharmacy systems, prescription adjudication, specialty pharmacy operations, and member journeys
* Proven solid analytical, logical reasoning, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Proven excellent verbal and written communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in Business, Technology, Healthcare, or a related discipline
* Experience with voice, digital, self\-service, IVR, contact center, chatbot, conversational AI, or customer engagement platforms
* Experience launching MVPs and managing products through the entire product lifecycle
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Rally, Aha!, or similar product management and requirements management tools
* Knowledge of OptumRx domain, prescription adjudication systems, specialty pharmacy subsystems, and prescription member workflows

 **About OptumRx**


OptumRx specializes in the delivery, clinical management, and affordability of prescription medications and consumer health products. Our goal is to deliver high\-quality, integrated services that promote optimal outcomes, superior savings, and outstanding client and consumer experiences.


At Optum, we are dedicated to helping make the health system work better for everyone. As part of a global organization, you'll have the opportunity to work on innovative healthcare solutions that impact millions of lives while collaborating with talented teams across business and technology.


Join us and help shape the future of healthcare through digital innovation.

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
